In narracione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\u252 \'fcbergeschr. \u11819 ? \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 intencionem explicat. In parte\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\u252 \'fcbergeschr. \u11819 ? \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 exordiali beneuolenciam captat. In conclusione propositum ipsius determinat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 timent enim penuriam victualium, opum et vestimentorum. Et istam partem penuriam excluditur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 1, Bl. 9EH; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 De Bruyne, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Pr\u233 \'e9faces Nr. I 1, S. 1-7;\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 , RB 284\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). \endash (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Prolog 2: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In principio creauit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Gn 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In presenti epistola tria facit, quia primo exponit opus creacionis, secundo opus distinctionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et describitur factum ante omnem diem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Druck: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Bd. 1, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Bl. 23B). \endash \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In principio creauit deus. Gen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [esis] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 primo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Fiat lux\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Gn 1,3). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Nota, quod illa lux solaris, que facta est prima die, adhuc fuit informis, quantum ad aliqua usque ad quartam diem, secundum quod dicit Dyonisius quarto capitulo de di\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [vinis] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 no\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [minibus] (Druck: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Bd. 1, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Bl. 24G). \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Firmamentum. Sub ipso celo cristallino est firmamentum, sub quo \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nomine intelligitur octava spera, que magis proprie dicitur firmamentum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod sperabat resurgere cum Christo resurgente, cui est honor\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Druck: Bd. 1, Bl. 24G-122H; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5829). \endash (11\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Schema, vgl. Druck Bd. 1, Bl. 51\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (45\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 6-46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Unbeschriebene L\u252 \'fccke: Kommentar zu Gn 41,50-57 fehlt, Text endet: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Vt harene maris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Gn 41,49). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Yperbolica est locucio ad exprimendum magnam quantitatem tritici\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 1, Bl. 108C); (46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Fortsetzung mit Gn 42,1. \endash (58\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Kolophon: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Anno 1454 decima die Aprilis feria quarta ante festum palmarum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (10. April 1454). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (58\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -93\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exodus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Hec sunt nomina\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (Ex 1,1), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 post quam Moyses descripsit eleccionem fidelis populi. Hic consequenter describit dacionem legis diuine illi populo sub fide unius dei adunato\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Locutus est dominus ad Moysen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (Ex 40,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Postquam descripta est tabernaculi construccionem, hic consequenter describitur eius erectio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 1, Bl. 123B letzte Zeile-212H; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5830). \endash (93\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vt predicta melius intelligantur, expressi hic in figura situm tabernaculi et atrii et eorum, que erant intra ipsam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod vna computabatur cum columnis longitudinis atrii, alia sequens cum columnis latitudinis alteri et eius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 duabus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Notandum, quod homo ordinatur ad deum per debite latere cultum, qui cultus principaliter consistit in actu interiori mentis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 animalia volatilia, de quibus agitur 2\u176 \'b0 ibi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Si autem de auibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et dicit primo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Vocauit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 1, Bl. 214DG). \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Uocauit autem Moysen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \u8249 \'8b (Lv 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Masculum offer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [e]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 t\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Lv 1,3), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quia femina est mas occasionatus et quid imperfectum respectu masculi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et consecracio predictorum aliquando cedebat in vtilitate sacerdotum, aliquando ad necessitatem ipsius templi. Druck Bd. 1, Bl. 271\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (131\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Kolophon: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 1454 in vigilia corporis Christi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (132\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -146\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Deut\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [e]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ronomius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Hec sunt uerba\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (Dt 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Iste liber diuiditur in prohemium et executionem, que incipit ibi: Cepitque Moyses\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 hic ponitur commendacio pre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [de]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 cessoris dicens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Et non surrexit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (Dt 34,10) (Druck: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Bd. 1, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Bl. 329C-377G; \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5833\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ). \endash (146\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) Kolophon: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Explicit Deuteronomius Anno 1454 in die S. Pauli commemoracionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (1. Juli 1454). \endash Rest der Seite sowie 146\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (147\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -152\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Prologus in librum Josue\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Tandem finito Pentatheucon Moysi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Iste prologus in quinque partes diuiditur principales. In quarum prima presens opus ordinat ad precedentem Pentateucon\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 primum describitur in libro Josue, secundum vero in aliis libris hystorialibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 2A-3G). \endash (147\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Et factum est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (Ios 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Iste liber diuiditur, quia primo determinatur de terre promissionis introitu, secundo de multiplici conflictu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 primum autem beneficium est reuocatio patrum ab \u1265 ?dolatria, quod notatur cum dicitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Trans fluuium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (Ios 24,2), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 scilicet Eufraten\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Explicit Iosue\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 3H-30A; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5834). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (152\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -154\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Incipit liber Judicum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Post mortem Iosue\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (Idc 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Deus populum Israel gubernauit et direxit tripliciter: Primo per iudices, secundo per reges, tertio per pontifices\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 circa primum preponitur motiuum compassionis, cum dicitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Jurauerant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (Idc 21,1) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 31C-55E; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5835). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (155\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Incpit liber Ruth\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In diebus unius iudicis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (Rt 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Hic consequenter ponitur tercius casus, scilicet ipsius Ruth. Et diuiditur in quattuor partes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et primo describitur citacio propinquiorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!, recte propinquorum) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 dicens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Ascendit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (Rt 4,1). \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Explicit Ruth\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 56C-59C; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5836). \endash Rest der Seite sowie 156\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (157\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -165\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Regum primus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Fuit vir unus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (I Sm 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Circa materiam illius libri et Paralipomenon sic proceditur, quia primo describitur populi Israel per reges gubernacio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et mortem pacienter sustinet, efficitur dignus vita eterna. Explicit regum primus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 62D-96G; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5837). \endash (166\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -171\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secundus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Factum est autem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (II Sm 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Postquam in primo libro actum est de regno per eleccionem, hic consequenter agitur de regno per successionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 propter quod populus erat puniendus, quod factum est per pestilenciam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 97D-124C; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5838). \endash (172\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -179\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tercius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Et rex Dauid\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b (III Rg 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In precedentibus libris actum est de regno Israel unito\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et ideo primo describitur belli tractatus, secundo congressus, ibi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Ascendit itaque\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (III Rg 22,29). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Primo dicit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Transierunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (III Rg 22,1) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 125D-160A; August 1454). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (185\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -188\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Paralipomenon primus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iste liber Paralipomenon diuiditur in duo, quia primo agitur de regno Israelis unito, secundo de bipertito\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et primo ponitur inuitacio regis uerbo d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [icente] \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Salomonem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (IV Rg 29,1) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 189G-213D; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5841). \endash (188\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -191\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Paralipomenon secundus. Incipit consequenter Esdras\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (191\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -193\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Liber Esdrae I. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus sub racione absoluta subiectum est in sacra scriptura\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quarto consummacio, ibi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Et consummati sunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (I Esr 10,17). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Dicit primo: Sic ergo orante\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (I Esr 10,1) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Bd. 2, Bl. 240A-253C; vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 RB 5844). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit Esdre primus. Nicht bei \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Rep. \endash Rest der Spalte und 257\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Der Fastenzyklus umfasst 84 Predigten, von denen 46 Predigten laut \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Schneyer, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Rep. 1, S. 150-222 (Hs. genannt S. 215), von Aldobrandinus Cavalcanti (1217-1279) verfasst worden sind. Der Nachweis dieser Predigten erfolgt mit Angabe von Seitenzahl und der von Schneyer vergebenen laufenden Nummer (s. Nr. 2-7, 11, 13, 22-24, 26-28, 30, 32-34, 36, 38, 41, 43, 46, 47, 49, 51, 53-57, 59, 61-63, 65-73, 75, 77). Bei 20 Predigten stimmt zwar das Bibelthema mit Schneyer \u252 \'fcberein, der \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Predigttext weicht jedoch ab, weshalb die Nachweise mit einem vgl. gekennzeichnet sind (s. Nr. 8, 10, 12, 16-21, 29, 31, 35, 40, 48, 60, 78-81, 83). Zwei Predigen werden von Schneyer in anonymen Sammlungen aufgef\u252 \'fchrt (s. Nr. 58, 64), w\u228 \'e4hrend 16 weitere bei Schneyer unbekannt sind (s. Nr. 1, 9, 14, 15, 25, 37, 39, 42, 44, 45, 50, 52, 74, 76, 82, 84).\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. auch Johannes Baptist \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Beobachtungen zu lateinischen Sermoneshandschriften der Staatsbibliothek M\u252 \'fcnchen. M\u252 \'fcnchen 1958 (Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Phil.-hist. Klasse 1958, 8), S. 105f. (Erw\u228 \'e4hnung des Predigtzyklus ohne Zuweisung an Cavalcanti).}

{\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg0\uc1\deff0\deflang0\deflangfe0{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil\fcharset1 Arial;}{\f1\fnil\fcharset0 Times New Roman;}{\f2\fnil\fcharset161 Times New Roman;}{\f3\fnil\fcharset238 Times New Roman;}}{\colortbl;\red0\green0\blue0;\red0\green0\blue255;\red0\green255\blue255;\red0\green255\blue0;\red255\green0\blue255;\red255\green0\blue0;\red255\green255\blue0;\red255\green255\blue255;\red0\green0\blue128;\red0\green128\blue128;\red0\green128\blue0;\red128\green0\blue128;\red128\green0\blue0;\red128\green128\blue0;\red128\green128\blue128;\red192\green192\blue192;}
\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -157\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Praecipuorum articulorum catholicae fidei explicatio \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Precipuorum articulorum catholic\u230 \'e6 fidei iam passim a neutericis in controuersiam ducuntur, pro iunioribus seu incipientibus per interrogationes breuis et succincta explicatio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De libero arbitrio. Precept\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [or]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quid est liberum arbitrium? Dis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [cipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Est facultas rationis et voluntatis, qua bonum eligitur gratia as\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [s]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 istente uel malum ea desistente\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Petrus Lombardus, Sententiae, lib. 2, dist. 24 \u167 \'a7 5; PL 24, 702) \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sed ut ea modo dentur, quo nobis sunt utilia ad uitam \u230 \'e6ternam, quam \u230 \'e6ternam uitam propriis uiribus habere non possimus sine gratia Dei gratum faciente, ut s\u230 \'e6pe dictum est etc. \plain \f2\i\lang1032\fs24\chcbpat8 \u932 \'d4\u949 \'e5\u955 \'eb\u959 \'ef\u962 \'f2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (24\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De fide, operibus ac meritis. Pr\u230 \'e6ceptor: Sunt ne bona opera hominibus uiatoribus adultis ultra fidem nece\u223 \'dfaria ad salutem? Dis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [cipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sunt. Nam illa fides (ut etiam herettici\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 concedant), que iustificat homines, debet esse fides viua et non mortua\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 at Christus, qui est frater noster maior et primogenitus. Rom 8\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (vgl. Rm 8,29). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Nos adiuuat porrigens dextram grati\u230 \'e6 su\u230 \'e6 etc. \plain \f2\i\lang1032\fs24\chcbpat8 \u932 \'d4\u949 \'e5\u955 \'eb\u959 \'ef\u962 \'f2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De inuocatione sanctorum. Pr\u230 \'e6ceptor\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sunt ne sancti dei iam demortui honorandi et inuocandi? Discip\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sunt utpote, qui suis meritis et precibus apud Deum pro nobis intercedere et orare possunt, quod multis scripturarum locis claret\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Dis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [cipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Hoc facit non ratione sanctitatis su\u230 \'e6 (nam ipse est homo atque alius, nesciens sicut ceteri, an amore uel odio dignus sit)\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 concessit Petro et cuilibet suo legittimo successore\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Gabriel Biel, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Sacri canonis missae expositio, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 lectio 49; \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 VD16 B5382, Bl. CCXXVI\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 9-15\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Alias enim nominat se etiam seruum seruorum Dei iuxta illud, qui maior sit uestrum sit minimus etc.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (vgl. Mt 23,11). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (72\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De Imaginum Adoratione seu Honoratione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . (72\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Pr\u230 \'e6cept\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [or]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Licet ne imaginem Christi uel alicuius sancti adorare seu honorare? Dis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [cipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Per se quedam non, sed quatenus est representatiua\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Eusebius scribit de imaginibus Petri et Pauli, meminit etiam imaginis Christi miracula facientis. Quid multa? Plena est sacra historia testimoniis de imaginibus etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \endash Schaltzettel: (74a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 H\u230 \'e6retici huius \u230 \'e6ui nostri ueneratione ipsarum imaginum sacrarum non uenerantur appellare idolatriam. Dicunt earum usum aduersarii Scripturis diuinis. Sed falluntur et Scripturas non intelligunt recte\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 qui insane dicunt, vsus imaginum esse idolatria et honorare sanctos esse contra pr\u230 \'e6ceptum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (78\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De Sanctorum reliquiis. P\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [raeceptor]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quid putas de sanctorum reliquiis, sunt ne venerand\u230 \'e6? D\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [iscipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sunt, tamquam ea, qu\u230 \'e6 fuerunt partes corporum sanctorum, non tamen eo modo proprio cultu, quo sancti venerantur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sequitur eum Jesus Christus secundum diuinam et humanam naturam simul, sub Eucharisti\u230 \'e6 speciebus uere continetur, quod ipse sit adoratione latrie adorandus. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (80\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De votis. Precept\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [or]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quid tenes de votis, sunt ne facienda et seruanda? Discip\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sunt utpote, qu\u230 \'e6 scriptura docet, natura dictat, honestas probat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sequuntur, quod Christus et Paulus, qui h\u230 \'e6c consuluerunt (ut supra ostensum est), essent Diaboli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (86\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De C\u230 \'e6libatu Monachorum et reliquorum Sacerdotum. Prae\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ceptor]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Decet, ne monachos et reliquos sacramentorum ministros seruare castitatem et esse c\u230 \'e6libes? Dis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [cipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Decet utpote, quod corpus et sanguinem dominicum atque reliqua sacramenta, in quibus nihil impuritatis est, conficiunt, contrectant et administrant, \u230 \'e6quum est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Dis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [cipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Castitas ante uotum est libera, sed uouenti nece\u223 \'dfaria, nec repugnat libertati Christus, sed potius emouet. Proinde ducere uxorem post uotum peccatum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [est], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ante vo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [tum] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 non\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (93\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De Veritate Corporis et sanguinis Domini Eucharistia. Prae\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ceptor]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Orta est his nostris temporibus pernitiosa h\u230 \'e6resis inter quosdam homines, aliqui a\u223 \'dferunt corpus Christi et sanguinem eius non e\u223 \'dfe in Sacra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [mento] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 realiter, sed tanquam in signo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Dis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [cipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quarta figura fuit in lege grati\u230 \'e6 sanguis fluens de Christi latere. Nam dormit Adam, ut fiat Eua, sic moritur Christus, ut fiat ecclesia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ex quo profluunt Sacramenta, quibus formatur Ecclesia \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 etc.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Augustinus, In Iohannis evangelium tractatus, tract. 9 \u167 \'a7 10; CCL 36, ed. Radbodus \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Willems\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 96 Z. 33-36\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8\cf1 ). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (110\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De Transvbstantiatione panis et vini in substantiam corporis et sanguinis Christi. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Pr\u230 \'e6\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ceptor]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Bene, astipulor iam tibi, quod corpus et sanguis Christi uere et realiter in Eucharisti\u230 \'e6 Sacramento contineantur \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 D\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [iscipulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Ambrosio dicente licet figura panis et vini uideatur, nihil tamen aliud quam caro et sanguinis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!, recte sanguis) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Christi post consecra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [tionem] \plain \f2\i\lang1032\fs24\chcbpat8 credendum est etc. \u932 \'d4\u949 \'e5\u955 \'eb\u959 \'ef\u962 \'f2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Thomas de Aquino, Sum. theol. III, qu. 75, art. 2 s.c.; \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 vgl. auch Ambrosius Mediolanensis, De sacramentis, lib. 4, cap. 5, \u167 \'a7 23; CSEL 73, S. 56 Z. 19-24). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (115\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f3\i\lang1024\fs24 De communione unius speciei. Pr\u281 \'eacept\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [or]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quia supra ostendisti corpus et sanguinem Christi realiter esse in Eucharistia et substantiam panis realiter mutari in substantiam corporis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 externo modo dicuntur saltem illi, qui sunt ordinati ad dispensanda sacramenta ecclesie, qui alio nomine appellantur sacrificuli, presbiteri, ministri ecclesiastici. Peccant igitur Lutherani, decepti per equiuocationis sophisma, non intelligentes, quomodo in scripturis sacris sacerdotis nomen iam generaliter pro quolibet Christiano homine, iam particulariter pro ministro ecclesi\u230 \'e6 sumatur etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (vgl. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Johannes Eck, Enchiridion, cap. 7; Edition: Enchiridion locorum communium adversus Lutherum et alios hostes ecclesiae. Mit der Zusammenfassung von Tilmann Smeling, O.P., hrsg. von Pierre \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Fraenkel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . M\u252 \'fcnster 1979, S. 116 Z. 2-4)\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \endash Rest der Seite leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (142\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De Purgatorio. Disci\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [pulus]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Uenerande magister, quia s\u230 \'e6pe dixisti, esse aliquem locum post hanc uitam, in quo piorum anim\u230 \'e6, non satis in presenti seculo pro peccatis commissis, contrit\u230 \'e6 uel expiat\u230 \'e6 purgantur, quem locum purgatorium appellant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Pr\u230 \'e6\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ceptor]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Chare discipule, quoniam nobis non constat, an amore uel odio digni simus uel quo tempore et quando liberentur anim\u230 \'e6 a purgatorio, ob id semper orare debemus. Quod si illis non est necesse, pro quibus fiunt orationes et suffragia ecclesi\u230 \'e6, tunc c\u230 \'e6teris fidelium animabus uel hic uel in purgatorio detentis proderunt iuxta doctrinam patrum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \endash Rest der Seite sowie 157\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 leer.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\qc\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 I (Bl. 1-75) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 I\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Inhaltsverzeichnis \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Liber de casibus. Item ammonicio de laude caritatis et quomodo preferatur virtutibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \u182 \'b6\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui stat, videat, ne cadat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -52\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Raimundus de Pennaforti: Summa de casibus poenitentiae (Recensio secunda abbreviata) \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Rubrikenverzeichnis f\u252 \'fcr Lib. 1-3 (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 nicht rubriziert, 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rubriziert). \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Prolog: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui stat, uideat, ne cadat, ait apostolus. Uidens enim apostolus homines ad casum uitiorum ab adolescentia sua procliuos, dicente domino, proni sunt sensus hominis in malum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 7-12) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Porro quoniam etiam omne opus bonum\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 facili in hoc tempore potest esse fastidii gaudentque breuitate moderni, gratum duxi et utile ad honorem domini nostri Ihesu Christi, qui abbreuiatus pro nobis uerbum abbreuiatum fecit s\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [uper] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 t\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [erram], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et ad utilitatem beniuolorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 discipulorum ac pauperum, a presenti opere pretermissis nouiculis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 iuris, opinionibus abrogatis ac disputationibus uariis, ipsam ueritatis sententiam abstrahere ac perinde quasi de summa summulam compilare\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -13\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Lib. 1, tit. 1: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De Symonia. Premittit quia hoc plurimum sapit naturam peccati. Peccatum enim auersio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [est] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 a bono incommutabili ad bonum commutabile. Symonia directe obuiat spiritu sancto cui bonitas appropriatur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash (tit. 16) \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 secus de infirmitate, de qua moritur, tunc enim ecclesia sua non priuabitur porcione similiaque in similibus iudicandum. Explicit liber primus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (13\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Lib. 2. \endash (27\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 letzte Zeile) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Incipit tercius liber\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b; (52\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) expl.: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 desperacio de magnitudine peccatorum, de quibus latius disserere alterius est negocii ad purum theologum et sermocinantem potius pertinentis. Hec ergo de penitencia hic dicta sufficiant. Primum est viciorum consuetudo, secundum est de uoto penitentis, iii ad domum inuitatio, iiii elemosinarum largicio, v ablatorum restitucio, vi gratie exhibicio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 domus autem refectionis dicitur, quia quod\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!, recte quot) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 membrorum officia iusticie seruiunt in sanctificacionem, tot quasi fercula deo preponuntur ad refectionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 (88\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De domina nostra sancta Maria sermo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Que est ista, que ascendit per desertum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Ct 3,3). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Nota, quod predicator quandoque loqui debet lingua hominum, quandoque lingua angelorum. Primo de peccatis et penis, secundo de laude uirginis et gloria celorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 securum habes accessum ad deum, o homo, ubi habes filium ante patrem, ante filium matrem. Mater ostendit filio pectus et ubera, filius ostendit patri latus et w\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [u]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 lnera, nec ulla potest esse repulsa, ubi tot caritatis occurrunt insignia. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (88\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Z. 28-33) \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Fructus florem non expungit, dum se fructus flori iungit in uirginis pomerio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sol luna lucidior et luna syderibus, sic Maria dignior creaturis omnibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (AH 54, S. 383f. Nr. 245 Str. 17). \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Rosa, crocus et lilium, omnem florum concilium cvm lignis aromaticis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 4\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Tv thronus Salomonis, cui nullus par in thronis arte uel materia \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (AH 54, S. 383f. Nr. 245 Str. 13). \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 5\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Ergo mater, o Maria, uirgo clemens, uirgo pia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 Borna-Leipzig 1952 (Ottendorfer Memorial Series of Germanic Monographs 16,3; Notker-Studien 3), S. 347-358, 380-382 Anm. 93-114 (Hs. genannt S. 380 Anm. 93f.); \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 G\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 lauch\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Martianus-Capella-Bearbeitung I (wie oben Lit.), S. 88f. mit Anm. 43, S. 93-96 (Hs. jeweils genannt). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (131\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Temperamentenlehre: \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quattuor sunt elementa mundi, quibus uisibilis iste perficitur mundus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 aer uidelicet ignis, terra, aqua, cum concordantia cum totidem aetatibus hominum puericia, adolescentia, iuuentute, senectute, cum huius modi eciam temporibus anni: vere, aestate\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 autumno, yeme, cum etiam paribus conuenientia humoribus: scilicet sanguine, colera rubea, melanconia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 flegma\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Annalis libellus, cap. 65: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cardinales sunt numeri ut i, ii, iii, iiii, v et ceteri in ordinem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ponderales uidelicet simplum, duplum, triplum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: (Nr. 1) Hubert \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Silvestre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Le commentaire in\u233 \'e9dit de Jean Scot \u201 \'c9rig\u232 \'e8ne au m\u232 \'e8tre IX du livre III du \u8218 \'82De consolatione philosophiae\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 \lquote \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 de Bo\u232 \'e8ce, in: Revue d'histoire eccl\u233 \'e9siastique 47 (1952), S. 44-122, hier S. 56 Z. 38-57 Z. 4 (mit Textumstellungen); \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\qc\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 I (Bl. 1-101) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -101\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Ps.-Bonaventura: Pharetra doctorum \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Prolog und Quellenverzeichnis. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Incipit liber qui dicitur Pharetra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In conuersionis mee primordio cum ob mentis recreacionem auctoritates sanctorum legerem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 originalia ista subscripta ipse excepi: De beato Gregorio. Moralia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Seneca\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Epystolas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De spiritu et anima et \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 aliqua de aliis libris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Kapitelverzeichnis zu lib. 1. \endash (3\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Incipit primum capitulum huius libri scilicet de deo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gregorius in Moralibus. Deus ipse manet intra omnia, ipse extra omnia, ipse supra omnia, ipse infra omnia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 illic dyabolus blanditur, ut fallat; arridet, ut noceat; illicit, ut occidat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Peltier\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Bd. 7, S. 64a vorletzte Zeile). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit primus liber huius operis et hic continet trecentas et lxxx\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 auctoritates\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (22\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) Lib. 2; (47\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) lib. 3; (71\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) lib. 4; cap. 50 \u8230 \'85 expl.: (98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Z. 11) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In uita illa si bonus fuerit, nihil pacietur, quod nolit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 si uero fuerit malus, ad omnia, que noluerit, cogetur et \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ab omnibus, que uoluerit, prohibetur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Im Anschluss an den in der Edition angef\u252 \'fchrten Textschluss weitere Zitate (in Auswahl): \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Z. 16) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tunc perfecte uacabimus maiore gratia referti et deo pleni\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quam dominus promittit, que per requiem Sabbati figurata est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Petrus Lombardus, In epistolam ad Hebraeos, cap. 4; PL 192, 432BC), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ut ait apostolus ad Hebreos iiii: Itaque relinquitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Hebr 4,9). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (99\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ibi sine omni ymagine corporis uidebimus perspicuam ueritatem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sed per speciem, omnis labor suscipitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Augustinus, Liber duodecimus, cap. 26; vgl. PL 34, 476, Z. 33-46). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (99\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 20) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Huius hereditatis possessor habebit ibi esse feliciter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et ita habebimus sancte trinitatis noticiam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Haimo Halberstadensis, Expositio in Apocalypsin, lib. 7, cap. 1; PL 117, 1209B). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (99\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De ieiunio et oracione, quid boni simul operentur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Gregorius in omilia: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hoc quod tibi subtrahis, alteri largire\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nihil enim homine orante proprie est potencius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (lib. 4, cap. 45, \u167 \'a7 4-5, ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Peltier\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Bd. 7, S. 219, mit Textumstellungen). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (99\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 vorletzte Zeile) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominum Ihesum sicut signaculum super cor tuum pone\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Ct 8,6), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ibi enim est tantus ostii custos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et angelorum custodiam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps.-Bernhardus Claraevallensis, Meditationes piissimae de cognitione humanae conditionis, cap. 4; vgl. PL 184, 494C). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 6\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (100\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 12) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In sermone: Non agit aliud participacio corporis et sanguinis Christi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vnde ipse dominus ait in ewangelio: Ego sum uia et ueritas et uita\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 14,6) \u8230 \'85 (Leo I. papa, Tractatus septem et nonaginta, tract. 63; vgl. CCL 138A, ed. Antoine \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Chavasse\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1973), S. 388 Z. 135-143). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 7\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (100\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 7) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In sermone de resurrectione Christi: Quid est uerbum dei? Quod dicetur non per uerbum hominis, hoc est uerbum dei \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et carnem humanam, animam humanam accepit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Augustinus, Sermo 237, cap. 4; PL 38, 1124). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 8\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (100\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 8) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Super illud Luce xv\u176 \'b0: Pater peccaui\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Lc 15,18). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Glosa: Etsi deus omnia nouit, uocem enim exspectat confessionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quia quod filius w\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [u]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 lt et pater\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Walahfridus Strabo, Evangelium secundum Lucam, cap. 15; PL 114, 312D). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 9\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (101\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 12) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Aymo super Apo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [calypsim]: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Pascit nos Christus, \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quia illuminat nos sua fide. Pascimus et nos uicissim Christum, quia letificamus eum fide nostra et opere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (s. Nr. 3, ebd. lib. 2, cap. 3; PL 117, 1001A). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 10\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (101\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 16) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominus, qui ianuam reserat, eciam sollicitudinem pulsantis exspectat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 si non inueniat suscipientis affectum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Eusebius Gallicanus, sermo 19; CCL 101, ed. Fran\u231 \'e7ois \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Glorie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1970)\plain \f2\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8\cf18 , \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 S. 229f. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\qc\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 III (Bl. 121-144) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 121\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Augustinus: Excerpta ex scriptis \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (121\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Im Kopfsteg: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus ad Julianum comitem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O mi frater, si cupis scire, quamuis ego nesciam quam perfectissima et plenissima sit iusticia. Iusticia est deum toto corde amare\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tu sicut pius pater respexisti, vt confiterer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Paulinus Aquileiensis, Liber exhortationis sive de salutaribus documentis, cap. 1-66. \endash Druck: PL 40, 1047-1078; PL 99, 197C-282C. \endash Lit.: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Glorieux\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Pour revaloriser Migne, S. 29; CPPM IIB, 3078. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb-\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 126\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus in Encheridione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad hoc primus homo in paradiso conditus fuerat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ad celestem angelorum patriam quandoque sine morte carnis transiret\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 4 \u167 \'a7 28; ed. CCL 143, S. 198 Z. 2-5). \endash (124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 26) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In eodem: Verba quippe dei de cordibus hominum molitur euellere, diabolus falsa enim pollicetur temporalia, vt mentibus hominum supplicia leuiget, que deus minatur eterna\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 24 \u167 \'a7 7; ed. CCL 143B, S. 1197 Z. 15-20). \endash (124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 vorletzte Zeile) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quem scilicet Adam tunc culpa duxit ad culpam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (expungiert) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 penam, nunc pena sua restringat a culpa, ut tanto magis delinquere metuat, quanto cogente supplicio, quod perpetrauit accusat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 24 \u167 \'a7 7; ed. 143B, S. 1197 Z. 30-33).\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \endash (124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Z. 1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In eodem. M\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ediator dei et hominum \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 instaurare omnia \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 uenit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 nde apostate angeli superbiendo ceciderunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Mor., lib. 31 \u167 \'a7 49; ed. CCL 143B, S. 1618 Z. 8-17). \endash Im Bundsteg: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De superbia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ; (Z. 14) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In eodem. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Superba voluntas facit dei precepta contempnere, humilitas custodire\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ita ruina omnium uirtutum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lib. scint., cap. 17, sent. 25, 26, 32; ed. S. 79). \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Im Bundsteg: \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De humilitate\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b (Z. 19) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In eodem. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si humilis et quietus non fueris, non potest habitare in te gracia spiritus sancti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et qui non habet caritatem perdit uitam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Lib. scint., cap. 4, sent. 16, 17, 19, 23, 34-36, 40, 41, 43, 44, 46-49, 51-53; ed. S. 19-22). \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (125\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) Im Seitensteg \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De compunctione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Z. 20) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui non habet compunctionem, nec habet mundam orationem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ibi spiritalis ignis accenditur, qui secreta mentis illuminat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lib. scint., cap. 6, sent. 6, 7, 17, 18; ed. S. 25f.). \endash (Z. 25) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quattuor sunt qualitates, quibus iusti viri anima in compunctione vehementer afficitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 si terrestris etc pensans\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 heu me\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quia incolatus etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . (Mor., lib. 23 \u167 \'a7 21; ed. CCL 143B, S. 1175f. Z. 25-58). \endash (125\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) Im Seitensteg: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De penitentia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ; (Z. 7)\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnis peccator in penitentia duplicem gemitum habere debet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 igni doloris ardemus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 32 \u167 \'a7 3; ed. CCL 143B, S. 1628f. Z. 31-68). \endash (125\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De reprehensione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (125\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De ieiunio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \endash (Z. 11) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De consuetudine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 C\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 um prodire culpa in vsu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [m]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ceperit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quasi tot vinculis ad mentem ligatur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 4 \u167 \'a7 27; ed. CCL 143, S. 195 Z. 74-95). \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De leuioribis peccatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (125\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De grauioribus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [peccatis]\u8249 \'8b \endash \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De desperacione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \endash \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De principibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hanc primam ruinam principes timeant, qui per priuatam gloriam semetipsos diligere non formidant, quia eo plenique intrinsecus corruunt quo male extrinsecus surgunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 17 \u167 \'a7 8; ed. CCL 143A, S. 856f. Z. 10-14), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 qui sorte potestatis accrescunt, transcendisse se vite meritis credunt; cunctis se estimant ampliores opere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte operibus), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quibus se uident amplius posse\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 26 \u167 \'a7 26; ed. CCL 143B, S. 1299 Z. 31-33). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quamuis quolibet in loco positi, princeps cogitando, loquendo et faciendo delinquat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 iuste sibi omnia estimat licere quod libet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor., lib. 5 \u167 \'a7 11; ed. CCL 143, S. 229 Z. 2-9). \endash (126\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De statu vite\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sollicite debet unusquisque uiuere et terminum uite sue considerare, ut de contemplacione illius huius seculi blandicias caueat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lib. scint., cap. 80, sent. 19; ed. S. 230). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Siglen: Lib. scint. = Defensor Locogiacensis, Liber scintillarum; Edition: CCL 117, ed. Henri \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Rochais\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1957). \endash Mor. = \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 Gregorius Magnus, Moralia in Iob; Edition: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 CCL\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 143-143B, ed. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Marcus \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Adriaen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1979-1985). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (126\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rab\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De die iudicii: Augustinus dicit, quod quedam signa facta sunt. Quedam cottidie senciuntur, sed, quidquid sit de aliis, duo maiora adhuc futura sunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash (Z. 12) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Percusso autem illo perdicionis filio et impiissimo tocius iniquitatis magistro ab ipso domino non continuo dies iudicii secuturus esse credendus est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et uita et salus et victus et copia et gloria et honor et pax et eterna beatitudo et beata eternitas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Flaccus Alcuinus, De fide sanctae trinitatis et de incarnatione Christi (De fide sanctae et individuae trinitatis), lib. 3, cap. 19-22. \endash Druck: \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs20 PL 101, 51B-54C. \endash Edition: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 CCCM 249, S. 5-147. \endash Lit.: CPPM IIA, 191. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4a\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (126\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus de fide ad Petrum. Fides est bonorum omnium fundamentum. Fides est humane salutis inicium. Sine hac nemo poterit ad filiorum dei numerum pertinere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in quantum exigit fidei et caritatis ratio tolerandos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 vorletzte Zeile) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Michi adherere deo etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 72,28). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Adherere deo, karissime, et in ipso spem tuam toto corde, fide et caritate constitue\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sine ambitu potestatum equaliter iudicabuntur domini et serui, reges et milites, diuites et pauperes, humiles et sublimes. Expliciunt excerpta Augustini de fide ad Petrum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (Nr. 4a) Claudius Gordianus Fulgentius, De fide ad Petrum. \endash Druck: PL 40, 753-779. \endash Edition: CCL 91A, 709 Z. 8-759 Z. 1418. \endash Lit.: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Glorieux\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Pour revaloriser Migne, S. 27; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Kurz, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 \u220 \'dcberlieferung Augustinus 5/1, S. 117-119 (ohne diese Hs.); CPL 826; CPPM IIA, 152. \endash (Nr. 4b) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Claudius Gordianus Fulgentius, Epistula 19 ad Faustinum. \endash Edition: CCL 91A, S. 628 Z. 35-52. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus contra quinque hereses\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Eia, fratres, certamen in promptu est, fervet opus, urget adversarius, spicula parat, iacere temptat, nemo expauescat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quid facere habetis, nisi ut credentes baptizemini, et bibatis sanguinem quem fudistis? \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Ps.-Augustinus (Quodvultdeus), Adversus quinque haereses, cap. 2-7. \endash Edition: CCL 60, ed. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 132\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -137\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Albertus Magnus: Excerpta \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (132\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Incipiunt excerpta de scriptis domini Alberti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Maius dicitur aliud alio quinque modis. Primo modo maioritate subiecti ut albedo equi albedine margarite, secundo maioritate durationis ut motus motu, tercio secundum intensionem ut albius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quarto secundum efficaciam ut virtus alia virtute, quinto secundum dignitatem ut caritas ceteris virtutibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 omne preceptum obligat nos ad conformandum in aliquo, sed nullum obligat ad conformitatem in genere preter hoc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Memento\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 Nicht identifiziert\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vab\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Nota, quod corpus multipliciter dicitur simplex. Dicit enim simplex, quidquid diuiditur diuisione continui tantum et sic corpora mathematica sunt simplicia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et ad quid resoluuntur omnia alia et sic ens dicitur simplex\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Summa de creaturis, tract. 3, qu. 7, art. 3, ad 3. \endash Edition: Alberti Magni \u8230 \'85 opera omnia. Bd. 34: Compendium theologicae veritatis in septem libros digestum, ed. Auguste \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Borgnet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . Paris 1895, S. 405. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -137\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Prophete, que\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!, recte qui) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 predicabant, legebant in libro vite. {\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg0\uc1\deff0\deflang0\deflangfe0{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil\fcharset1 Arial;}{\f1\fnil\fcharset0 Times New Roman;}}{\colortbl;\red0\green0\blue0;\red0\green0\blue255;\red0\green255\blue255;\red0\green255\blue0;\red255\green0\blue255;\red255\green0\blue0;\red255\green255\blue0;\red255\green255\blue255;\red0\green0\blue128;\red0\green128\blue128;\red0\green128\blue0;\red128\green0\blue128;\red128\green0\blue0;\red128\green128\blue0;\red128\green128\blue128;\red192\green192\blue192;\red204\green238\blue221;}
\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -33\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Hugo Argentinensis: Compendium theologicae veritatis (lib. 3, 6) \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Kopfsteg: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Assit ad inceptum virgo Maria meum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash Lib. 6: De sacramentis.\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Celestis medicus humani generis reparatiuus, tali modo sanauit egrotum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quamuis igitur apud hereticos sunt sacramenta vna non tamen recipientibus vtilia non ad ecclesie redeant vnitatem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Drei \u220 \'dcbersichtsschemata: \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Septem sunt sacramenta noue legis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Baptismus primum a peccato mundat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Confirmacio secundum in bonis confirmat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 4 Abs. 1 S. 203a); \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Primum est sacramentum intrancium et ordinatur contra peccatum originale\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 5 Abs. 1 S. 203b und Abs. 4 S. 204a); \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Primum et disponit ad fidem, secundum et disponit ad spem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 5 Abs. 3 S. 204a). \endash Weitere Schemata: (7\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -9\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qualiter ad communionem accedendum sit, discere possumus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In esu agni pascalis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \lquote . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Comedebant enim iudei agnum pascalem accinctis renibus, per quod significatur puritas castitatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (De eucharistia, cap. 12-17, S. 210a-217b). \endash (11\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -12\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vera est penitenda non committere et admissa deflere. Falsa vnde ysidorus irrisor est et non penitens, qui adhuc agit quod penitet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (De confessione, cap. 21, S. 220f.). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 Lib. 3: De peccato. (19\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -21\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vnum peccatum dicitur mayus, alio multis modis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Causalitate ut peccatum Luciferi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 generalitate ut peccatum Ade\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 5, S. 92b); \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item peccatorum aliud: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ex amore male accedente\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ex timore male humiliante\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 6, S. 92f.). \endash (22\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -27\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Inanis glorie secundum Gregorium septem sunt filie scilicet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Inobediencia, quia vanigloriosus in nullo inferior wult videri, quod fieret, si faceret mandatum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 15-21, S. 105b-115a). \endash (28\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -29\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In remittendo peccata duo sunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 misericordia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 contra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 primum est desperacio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et illa dicuntur peccata in s\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 piritum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 s\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 anctum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quamuis enim omne peccatum sit contra deum trinum et vnum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 29, S. 119b-120a). \endash (29\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Merkverse: \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item quatuor sunt clamancia peccata: Clamitat in celum vox sanguinis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 2821); \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quinque sunt casus principales ad papam pertinentes. Ad papam feriens clerum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 411); \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sex sunt peccata in spiritum sanctum. Inuidus impugnans, presume\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 n\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 s, inpenitensque \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 9552); \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nouem sunt aliena peccata. Iussu consilio consensu laude recursu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 9990; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Bloomfield \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (mit Supplement) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 2877); \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Casus episcopales patent in hiis metris. Qui facit incestum, deflorans aut homicida\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 15482). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 Lib. 6: De sacramentis. Continuatio. (29\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Extrema vnctio est sacramentum ecclesie de oleo et balsamo uel alterutrum alterius gratie collatum. Et tam sunt genera vnccionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tercia vero vnccio est, que dicitur oleum infirmorum, de qua nunc agitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Petrus Lombardus, Sententiae, lib. 4, dist. 23 \u167 \'a7 1; ed. PL 192, 899); (Z. 18) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vbi sciendum, quod de substantia huius sacramenti sunt quinque\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 35 Abs. 2, S. 231b); (30\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) cap. 36-37 (mit Textumstellungen, endet im Druck S. 231b Z. 26); (32\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ostiarii secundum Ysidorum dicti sunt eo, quod presint hostiis templi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sed propter honorem et dignitatem quam acceperunt, presbitery nominantur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Petrus Lombardus, Sententiae, lib. 4, dist. 24 \u167 \'a7 3-9; vgl. PL 192, 901-904). \endash (32\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Matrimonium siue coniugium et legittima coniunctio maris et femine, indiuiduam vite consuetudinem retinens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 proles, ut ad cultum dei nutriatur. Et sacramentum, ut non dissoluatur. Et sic est finis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (cap. 38 S. 235a Z. 1-27). \endash Rest der Seite leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Textausz\u252 \'fcge aus den B\u252 \'fcchern 3 und 6, h\u228 \'e4ufig als paraphrasierende Wiedergabe in Form von Schemata; mit Interpolationen. \endash Edition: Alberti Magni \u8230 \'85 opera omnia. Bd. 34: Compendium theologicae veritatis in septem libros digestum, ed. Auguste \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Borgnet\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Paris 1895, S. 90-121, 201-236\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 . \endash Lit.: Zum Werk allg. vgl. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Georg\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Steer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Hugo Ripelin von Stra\u223 \'dfburg. Zur Rezeptions- und Wirkungsgeschichte des \u8218 \'82Compendium theologicae veritatis\lquote im deutschen Sp\u228 \'e4tmittelalter. T\u252 \'fcbingen 1981 (Texte und Textgeschichte 2); \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 d\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ers\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ., in: \u178 \'b2VL 4 (1983), Sp. 252-266, hier Sp. 255-257.}
