\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Enumeratio peccatorum \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Licet enim septem peccata capitalia vnacum suis filiabus atque speciebus sparsim sew diuisim enumerata sint supra. Nichilominus tamen, que et quot sint filie et species ac eciam differencie singulorum cum aliis quibusdam peccatis pertinentibus ad ea\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [n]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dem ad superius non dum numeratis, que tamen consimiliter vtilia et necessaria videntur ad confessionem in sequentibus clarius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (beschnitten) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 patet intuenti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (47\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -50\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) CTV, lib. 3, cap. 30-33: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Hec sunt peccata cordis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Cogitacio, delectacio, consensus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 (cap. 30); (47\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Item peccata oris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b (cap. 31); (48\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Secuntur peccata operis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b (cap. 32); (49\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Secuntur peccata obmissionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b (cap. 33). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (50\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) Sum. Peraldi, lib. 2, tract. 6, pars 3 (De superbia): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Affectus quatuor habet species. Quando aliquis credit se bona sua habere a se; quando credit se habere bonum, quod non habet; quando credit se habere a deo sed pro meritis suis; quando aliquis in opinione sua prefert se aliis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. cap. 1-3, Bl. cxxxii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -cxxxiiii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Superbia est duplex\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Interior\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Intellectus duas species habet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 presumpcionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 , \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 appetitum proprie excellecie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (vgl. cap. 5, Bl. cxxxv\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 , cap. 6, Bl. cxxxvi\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ); \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Exterior sit in corpore et in omnibus eius membris a uertice usque ad plantam pedis inclusiue\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (vgl. cap. 9, Bl. cxli\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ); (51\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 In cantu, in quo quatuor\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [sunt] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sensibilia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 fraccio vocis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 , \endash \plain Confiteor deo omnipotenti et vobis patri, quod a proxima mea confessione non custodiui me a peccatis, sicut proposui \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et rogo uos, ut dicatis mihi absolucionem et iniungatis mihi penitenciam et essetis deum pro me. Hec ille\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (123\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Aliud\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quia ad remissionem peccatorum requiratur: contricio amara, confessio pura, satisfactio condigna\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sin autem de tercio in tercium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [diem] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 saltem studeas confiteri et ut confitearis annuatim. 1453\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) Schuldkapitel nach der Prim: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Ego dico culpam meam omnipotenti deo et beato Benedicto, toti congregacioni et vobis patri. Primo de sancta regula, que non seruaui secundum possibilitatem meam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et de omnibus aliis excessibus et peccatis meis dico\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 culpam meam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (expung.) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domino et beato Benedicto et toti congregacioni et vobis patri uel patribus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De temptationibus agonizantis: Quinque temptaciones sunt, quando morituri sunt homines, quia in extremis grauiores sunt temptaciones tales, quales in vita numquam habuerunt. Primo, quarum vna est in fide\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nam qui bene et secure mori voluerit, debet omnia temporalia et exteriora simpliciter atque totaliter postponere et se deo totum plenarie committere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (Nr. 1) Breviarium caeremoniarum monasterii Mellicensis, ed. Joachim F. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Angerer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . Siegburg 1987 (Corpus consuetudinum monasticarum 11,2), cap. 33 S. 236. \endash (Nr. 2) Ps.-Bonaventura, Regula novitiorum, cap. 3; Edition: Sancti Bonaventurae opera omnia. Bd. 8: Opuscula varia ad theologiam mysticam et res Ordinis Fratrum Minorum spectantia, ed. studio et cura PP. Collegii a Sancta Bonaventura. Quaracchi 1898, S. 479. \endash (Nr. 4) Parallel\u252 \'fcberlieferung: Augsburg, SuStB, 4\u176 \'b0 Cod. 149, 127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ; N\u252 \'fcrnberg, GNM, Hs 101221, 204\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ; Druck: GW 2610 = BSB-Ink A-766, Bl. a iii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Z. 19-a\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 [v]\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 Z. 23\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (125\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Notandum est, quod inter cetera vota votum obediencie est melius. Vnde maximum votum est obediencia, vnde obediencia est subiectio proprie voluntatis. Vnde Bernhardus: Christus maluit perdere uitam quam obedienciam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. PL 182, 939AB) \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 septimum est, proprium consilium primum est malum, secundum est pessimum. Hec Bernhardus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 6\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (125\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quid, si aliquis videns aliquod monasterium, vbi monachi splendide uiuunt, cogitat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hunc ordinem bene possum sustinere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \lquote \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et sic ingreditur \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nec potest allegare dolum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 7\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quid, si aliquis ingredietur aliquem religionem sub condicione aliqua. Responditur secundum Wilhelmum, si potest condicio aliqua contra substanciam religionis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quam profitetur, tenetur, secus si nescit uere in omni contineri\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 8\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (126\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur, an per ingressum religionis consequitur quis remissionem omnium peccatorum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ad promocionem ad penam in bonum, que preponderat absolucioni a peccatis, alia littera\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 a pena\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II\u170 \'aa-IIae, qu. 189 art. 3 ad 3). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 9\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item ingressi ad monasteria se et sua dedicant deo, omnia enim eorum bona intelliguntur monasterio esse collata \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [et a] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 minori tempore non currit contra ecclesiam prescriptio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 10\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (126\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Qveritur, utrum aliquis debeat alios inducere ad religionis ingressum. Responditur secundum Thomam 2\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 a\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 2\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 e\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 in questione vltima: I\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nducentes alios ad religionem non solum non peccant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 qui ad iustitiam erudiunt multos, quasi stelle etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II\u170 \'aa-IIae, qu. 189 art. 9 conclusio). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 11\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qveritur, utrum religiosus peccet mortaliter transgredi \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 transgrediendo ea que sunt in regula. Responditur secundum Thomam 2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [a]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 e\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 questione eadem dicens: Votum professionis respicit principaliter tria, scilicet paupertatem, continentiam et obedientiam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 transgressio uel obmissio non obligat ad culpam mortalem neque venialem, sed solum ad penam taxatam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II\u170 \'aa-IIae, qu. 186 art. 9). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 12\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Alia questio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sed quali habitu debet indui nouicius. Respondetur, quod duplex traditur habitus et sic est duplex tradicio: primus nouiciorum, secundus confessorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 in antiquis vide Arch\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [idiaconus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ne cle\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rici\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 uel mo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 nachi saecularibus negotiis se immisceant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 c. 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (X 3.50.2). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (Nr. 6)\plain \f2\lang1033\fs20\cf1 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Edition: Sanctus Raimundus de Pennaforte. Die susceptio habitus und ihre Rechtsfolgen bis zum Konzil von Trient, in: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Studien und Mitteilungen zur Geschichte des Benediktiner-Ordens und seiner Zweige 108 (1997), S. 7-79\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 13\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Ut sepe admonitus, scilicet criminaliter, secrete et aperte, si non correxerit, scilicet vitam suam et vicia, etiam episcopus adhibeatur in testimonium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Regula Benedicti, cap. 62). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Dicunt quidam, quod illud habeat locum in monasteriis non exemptis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quod adhuc remanet in foro abbatis iudicandus ab eo. Et sic, cum alii ducuntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 per septem gradus, iste ducetur per octavum. Sunt autem isti\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : secreta admonicio, secundus publica correptio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 eiectio octauus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 14\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Z. 10) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Istam autem expulsionem quidam interpretatur quoddam genus excommunicacionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 alii autem de eiectione ab ordine habitu ablato et sicut forte fuit consuetudinis tempore Benedicti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 15\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Z. 17) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De illa expulsione monasterii siue septem graduum habeatur plures in regula puta in 28 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 capitulo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vtatur abbas ferro abscisionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \lquote ; weitere Kapitel aus der Benediktsregel: cap. 58, 62, 65, 71. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 1453 in die Karoli Magni sumptis in Kastello\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (28. Januar 1453). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 FA Monachus ordinis Benedicti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 16\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nouicius vtrum pubes, scilicet annum quattuordecim, possit intrare religionem, ut sit ibi nouicius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 17\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Z. 8) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur, quod est tempus probacionis in nouicio. Respondetur xv\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 us\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 annus, cum non possit ingredi nec expleto xiiii anno, quod tunc incipiat annus probacionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Extra, De re\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 gularibus et transeuntibus ad religionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Beneficium, li 6\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 = VI 3.14.4) \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Extra de re\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 gularibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 etc. 1453\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 in die\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 purificacionis M\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [arie] (2. Der gr\u246 \'f6\u223 \'dfte Anteil mit 95 Predigten entf\u228 \'e4llt auf den Franziskanerprediger Johannes de Castello (Nr. 2a, 5-7, 11f., 14, 16-23, 27, 29-39, 41-44, 46-50, 53f., 58f., 63-74, 76, 76a, 80, 85f., 88, 90, 100f., 106, 108f., 111, 113f., 117f., 120-122, 125, 127-131, 134-136, 147, 193f., 197, 203f., 206f., 210f., 217f., 223 sowie eine nicht von Schneyer erfasste Predigt auf 80\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ; Nummern im Textbestand jeweils kursiv). Nota de cornu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte corvo) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ad laycos misso\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Sermo 1, S. 321b-322b Z. 37). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (114\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 465: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [P]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 osui uos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 15,16). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In hac duplici missione tota uita apostolorum significatur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 hec enim, si assint nobiscum nec sine fructu constat nos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Sermo 4, S. 325b Z. 21-327a Z. 45). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (115\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 466, expl.: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nota, quantum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 simplicitas conuenit nobis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Sermo 5, S. 327b-329a); (116\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 3) Zusatz, expl.: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et in caritate perpetua dilexi te, ideo attraxi te, miserans de presenti misera\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ier 31,3). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 De evangelistis (C3). \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (116\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 471, Bibelthema abweichend: Ps 18,5 statt Sir 15,5 (Druck: Sermo 1, S. 332b-333b Z. 38). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 6\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (116\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 473 (Druck: Sermo 3, S. 334b-335b). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 De uno martyre (C4). \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 7\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (117\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [P]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 etrus ad se reuersus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Act 12,11). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Petrus interpretatur agnoscens et signat quemlibet peccatorem christianum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Rep. 6, S. 176 Nr. 25; Bd. 7, S. 631 Nr. 252; Bd. 8, S. 571 Nr. 132). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 8\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (118\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [H]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ec mando uobis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 15,17). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hodierne diei festiuitas, que in laudem et gloriam agitur saluatoris causa tripliciter \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?),\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 qualiter beatus N. apostolus glorie coronam accipere meruit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 9\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [E]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 iecit Salomon Abiathar \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (III Rg 2,27). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In quibus uerbis notatur iusti electio, peruersi abiectio siue repobacio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 10\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (119\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 474 (Druck: Sermo 1, S. 336a-337a, mit Abweichungen). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 11\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (119\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 477, expl.: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ut ipsum decoquas laboribus et sudoribus, vigiliis, ieiuniis et disciplinis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Sermo 4, S. 339a-340a Z. 4); (120\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 22-25) Zusatz, expl.: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 si quis ergo ministrauit, sic honorabit eum, ut dicit apostolus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?, wohl f\u252 \'fcr psalmista): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nimis ho\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [norificati] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sunt a\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [mici] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 t\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ui], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [eus] (Ps 138,17). \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 12\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (120\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 478 (nicht im Druck). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 13\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (121\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Nr. 482, expl.: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in tertia ardent feliciter, vnde\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 kaminus in Iherusalem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (Is 31,9), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 in quarta ardent rebrobi tamen eternaliter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: Sermo 5, S. 340b-342a). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 De uno confessore (C6). \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 14\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (121\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [S]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 int lumbi vestri precincti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 12,35), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 qui sunt triplex precinctio amoris, pudoris et honoris. Primum est in membrorum restrictione, secundum in caritatis perfectione, tercium in glorie adopcione. Primum est lumborum, secundum pectoris, tercium capitis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 per malum exemplum. Ecclesiasticus xiii: Qui tetigerit picem, inquinabitur ab illa\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Sir 13,1). Vgl. Nr. 498 (nicht im Druck). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 De pluribus martyribus (C5). \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 15\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (121\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [S]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 i quis mihi ministrat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 12,26). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quia transitum laudabilem huius martiris N. hodierna die recolimus, non immerito verba proposita Luce ewangeliste eius festivitatem cooperamus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 16\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (122\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [N]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 olite mirari\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I Io 3,13). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hic dei filius sanctis martyribus loquitur ipsos confortando, ut in passione inueniantur stabiles et in operacione consciencie efficaces\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 17\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (123\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [S]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 int lumbi vestri precincti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 12,35) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 carnis uel mentis. Petrus i\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. I Pt 1,13). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Precincti, ne defluat in terrena; precincti fune paupertatis Iob xxxvi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Iob 36,8) \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quinto uiam demonstrat ad paradysum, vnde ait Iohannes xii: Ambulate dum lucem habetis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 12,35). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Druck: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Sancti Francisci Assisiatis \u8230 \'85 nec non Sancti Antonii Paduani \u8230 \'85 Opera Omnia \u8230 \'85, ed. \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 xcv di. c. Episcopus in ecclesia (D.95 c.10) et sic de illo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Johannes de Deo, Excerpta ex poenitentiali, lib. 5, cap. 6, PL 99, 1094A-1099B). \endash (20\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Im Fu\u223 \'dfsteg:\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui facit incestum, deflorans aut homicida\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 15482)\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (21\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota, ad quod valet confessio, oratio, elemosine et alia bona opera extra caritate\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [m]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 facta\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 inveni vas vacuum, sed signatum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 3.34.138, Bl. cc\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ); (21\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 25) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Oracio vero peccatoris ex bono nature desiderio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ad salutem pie et perseueranter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 3.34.118, Bl. cxcvi\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ); (21\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 6) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iste condiciones sic exponuntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Primo per se, quia merito condigni vnus alterius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte alteri) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 gratiam non meretur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 numquam est inefficax oracio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 3.34.121, Bl. cxcvi\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ); (21\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 drittletzte Zeile) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sunt enim tredecim condiciones secundum Rey\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [mundum], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 que in oracione exiguntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 in oracione spiritum sanctum acceperunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (vgl. Act 1,14). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (22\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De potestate et vsu clauium ecclesie. Clauis ecclesie sic distribuitur secundum Pe\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [trum] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 in sacra scriptura xviii di\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . (Petrus Lombardus, Sent. 4.18) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 clauis est quedam potencia spiritualis supernaturaliter a deo data et infusa\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quamuis potestas clauium quo ad essenciam maneat cum eis et hoc de illo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 3.34.171-176, Bl. cciiii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rab\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (22\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De feriis sicut dicit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De feriis solempnibus siue festis, in quibus honor ipsi deo debitus a plerisque subtrahitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 seu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [sufficit dispensatio] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 simplici\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [s] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sacerdot\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [is] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 discreti tamen secundum Rey\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [mundum] (SC 1.12.1-8, Bl. xxxiii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -xxxiiii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 6\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (24\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Uidendum est de ieiunio, utrum cadat sub precepto. Secundum Tho\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [mam] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 dicendum est, quod ieiunium quantum pertinet ad necessitatem cohybicionis peccati\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et magis ad humorem luxurie ceteris cooperatur secundum In\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [nocentem] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et Host\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [iensem] \u8230 \'85 (SC 1.12.15-33, Bl. xxxiiii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -xxxv\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 7\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (25\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Indulgencie aliquid valeant, est uidendum. Ad hoc tamen, ut valeant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [indulgentiae], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quattuor requiruntur. Duo ex parte dantis et duo ex parte suscipientis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 cum papa hanc plenitudinem potestatis ut supra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (SC 3.34.180-191, Bl. cciiii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -ccvi\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 8\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (26\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sacerdos quilibet maxime habens curam animarum canones penitentiales scire debet et sunt xlvi in numero secundum Host\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [iensem] \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 de quibus vide supra in sacramento penitencie circa finem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (SC 3.34.125, Bl. cxcvii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 -cxcix\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 9\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (29\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Homicidium est hominis occisio ab homine factum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod sacerdotes sacris tubis in bellis ewangelizarent secundum Thomam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 2.1.1-49, Bl. xlix\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -liii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 10\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (30\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quot\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte quod) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 peccatum sit maius inter infideles\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ? \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dic secundum Tho\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 mam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 infidelitas hereticorum, qui profitentur fidem ewangelii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 secundum quid tamen possent cooperari\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 3.34.125, Bl. ccvii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 11\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (30\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 13) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota secundum Tho\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 mam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod tria requiruntur ad bellum iustum. Primo auctoritas principis, quam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte quia)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 priuata persona ius suum potest in iudicio prosequi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 si aliquod istorum defuerit, bellum dicitur iniustum secundum Rey\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [mundum] \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 2.5.45, Bl. lxii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vab\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , mit Umstellungen). \endash (30\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 drittletzte Zeile) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In bello enim viribus nitunur bellantes non iure\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dum modo non excedat legittimum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 modum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (SC 2.5.167-173, Bl. lxxvii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -lxxvii\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , mit Umstellungen). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Ausz\u252 \'fcge aus der Summa confessorum des Johannes de Friburgo (Sigle: SC) sowie weiteren Interpolationen, darunter das Rationale divinorum officiorum des Guilelmus Durantis (Sigle: RDO); Nachweis lediglich einmal zitierter Werke s. Beschreibung. \endash Die Kompilation diente wohl als Priesterhandbuch; nach der Sakramentenlehre (Nr. 1) werden behandelt: (Nr. 2) Stundengebet; (Nr. 3-4) Beichte einschlie\u223 \'dflich Absolution (claves ecclesiae); (Nr. 5) kirchliche Feste; (Nr. 6) Fasten; (Nr. 7) Ablass; (Nr. 8) Seelsorge (cura animarum); (Nr. 9) Bestrafung bei Mord; (Nr. 10) H\u228 \'e4resie; (Nr. 11) gerechter Krieg (bellum iustum). \endash Druck/Edition: Johannes de Friburgo, Summa confessorum. Paris: Jean Petit, 1519. \endash Guilelmus Durantis, Rationale divinorum officiorum. Neapel 1859\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 .}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 31\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -38\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Gregorius Magnus: Moralia sive Expositio in Job \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Job de prelatis. Habundant tabernacula predonum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Hiob 12,6). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Prelati dicuntur raptores, quia pecuniam a subditis extorquent et rebus ecclesie abutuntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et pingwedinem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte pinguedine) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 peccatorum suorum ignis iehenne incenduntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte incenditur). \endash (31\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Job\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ego vidi stultum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Hiob 5,3). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gregorius hoc moralisat sic quasi firma radice stultus in terra vigitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!, recte figitur) \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ejus pomppam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sine dilacione reprobavi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor. 6.6.7-8, CCL 143, S. 288f. Z. 2-56). \endash (31\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sanctus Augustinus hic dicit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Augustinus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 De mundo vide\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 O munde inmunde, quit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (!, recte quid) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 alliceres, cum esses permanens, cum fugiens tot teneas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 nam sua dulcedo dilabitur \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ordine fedo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (31\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 20) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gregorius in moralibus: Qui presentis mundi delectacione pascitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 inde in intimis obstupescunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor. 11.33.45, CCL 143A, S. 611 Z. 24-28); (Z. 26) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Idem Gregorius ibidem: Si subtiliter consideretur omne quod hic agitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 contra estum frigora requirantur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mor. 11.49.66, CCL 143A, S. 623 Z. 26-29). \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (32\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Ad quid portanda\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 sicut Superpellicium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Item superpellicium propter sui candorem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quod caritas operit multitudinem peccatorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (RDO 3.1.10-12, S. 102). \endash \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Sanctus Gregorius hic dicit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b Weitere Zitate in Auswahl (lediglich Stellennachweis): \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Mor. 15.31.37, CCL 143A, S. 771 Z. 4-7; (Z. 26) Mor. 16.5.6, CCL 143A, S. 800f. Z. 12-28, mit Umstellungen. \endash (32\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 12) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Spiritus sanctus in septem donis veneratur, sicut per prophetam est prenunciatum, que dona poteris hic videre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (vgl. Is 11,2-3). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hec sunt septem mulieres, que vnum virum apprehendent\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Is 4,1), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quia septem dona spiritus sancti solum Christum corporaliter possiderunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in futuro ab omni opere feliciter requiescemus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Wernerus de Sancto Blasio, Libri deflorationum, lib. 1, Sermo in die pentecostes, PL 157, 984C-988A). \endash (33\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 24) Mor. 11.24.35, CCL 143A, S. 606 Z. 2-4; (33\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 7) Mor. 11.9.12, CCL 143A, S. 592 Z. 13-15; (Z. 15) Mor. 12.28.33, CCL 143A, S. 648 Z. 12-16; (Z. 22) Mor. 12.53.60f., CCL 143A, S. 666 Z. 46-55; (34\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 11) Mor. 12.55.64, CCL 143A, S. 668 Z. 8-20; (34\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 2) Mor. 15.56.63-66, CCL 143A, S. 789-790 Z. 1-75 (mit Auslassungen); (Z. 18) Mor. 16.24.29, CCL 143A, S. 815 Z. 1-18; (34\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 14) Mor. 16.25.30, CCL 143A, S. 816 Z. 38-42; (Z. 20) Mor. 16.41.51, CCL 143A, S. 828 Z. 5f.; (Z. 22) Mor. 16.59.72, CCL 143A, S. 840f. Z. 11-26; (34\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 19) Mor. 17.7.9, CCL 143A, S. 855f. Z. 9-20. \endash (35\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 6) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Responde stulto iuxta stulticiam suam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Prv 26,5). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (35\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Notandum quod quinque sunt astucie serpentis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Notandum quod quinque sunt astucie serpentis, quibus prudencia sanctorum debet assimilari\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 quas habet mundus cum eis, fugiunt eum. Prima Jo iii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Nolite mirari\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 (I Io 3,13) (\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Guilelmi Peraldi \u8230 \'85 Summae virtutum ac vitiorum tomus I et II. Hac postrema editione \u8230 \'85 studio et opera Rodolphi \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Clutii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Vnde pater\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Eructauit cor meum, verbum bonum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 44,2) \u8230 \'85 \endash (118\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quia Christus Ihesus est deus et dominus omnium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Istas auctoritates scripturarum obiciunt nobis Iudei et heretici abnegantes, Christum esse deum et dominum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Recapitulacio supra dictorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 de regno eterno eius et de futuro eius aduentu ad iudicandum viuos et mortuos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Ed.: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 (139\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quod Invitatorium, Ant., \u8479 ?, R\u8483 ?, \u8483 ?) nahezu identisch sind. Zu dem gedruckten Brevier, das von dem Emmeramer M\u246 \'f6nch und Custos Hieronymus Wei\u223 \'df herausgegeben und bei Adam Berg 1571 in M\u252 \'fcnchen verlegt wurde, vgl. auch MBK 4/1, S. 131f.}

H\u246 \'f6chste Festgradangabe \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In summis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 an Weihnachten, Epiphanie, Peter und Paul, Benedikt (11.07.), Patrone des Klosters (Mitte August), Mari\u228 \'e4 Himmelfahrt, Allerheiligen sowie Emmeram (22./23.09.), Dionysius (09.10.), Wolfgang (31.10.); bei h\u246 \'f6heren Festen Anzahl der Lektionen und Lichter angegeben (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 xii lectiones, iii, v, vii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 oder \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 xv lumina\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ); \u8210 - Bemerkenswert: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Erhardi ep. et cf. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rot 08.01.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Caroli imperatoris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 28.01.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Georii mr.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rot 24.04.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Translacio s.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Katherine v. et mr. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 05.07.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Margarethe v. et mr. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rot 12.07.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Osbaldi et Affri regum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 05.08.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hilarie et sociorum eius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 12.08.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Commemoracio vel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sollemnitas patronorum nostrorum semper agitur proxima dominica post transfiguracionem domini\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 gegen Mitte August; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tricesimus assumpcionis domine nostre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 13.09.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Emmerammi mr.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rot 22.09.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dedicacio ecclesie s. Emmerammi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 23.09.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Translacio s. Wolfgangi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 07.10.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dionysii sociorumque eius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rot 09.10.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Wolfgangi ep. et cf.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 rot 31.10.; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Translacio s. Emmerammi que celebratur proxima dominica post animarum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Anfang November; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Translacio s. Dionysii que tunc celebratur semper proxima dominica ante aduentum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Anfang Dezember. \u8210 - Vorbesitzereintr\u228 \'e4ge \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hac die ego frater Benedictus professus sum dominica Reminiscere 1488\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2. M\u228 \'e4rz); \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hac die intraui monasterium tercia feria post Inuocauit 1487\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6. M\u228 \'e4rz). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 IX\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -X\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Registrum de tempore\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b. Verzeichnis der Feste im Jahreslauf mit zugeh\u246 \'f6rigen Hymnen, Kapiteln und Kollekten, zitiert aus Bl. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 63\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 bis \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 246\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \u8210 - X\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer.}

Pro pace \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus auctor pacis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Corpus orationum 1110; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ecclesie tue\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quesumus domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 preces placatus admitte \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; De Maria et omnibus sanctis \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fac nos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quesumus domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sancte Marie semper virginis subsidiis attolli \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Sechs Gebete, zuletzt Corpus orationum\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 3134 B; Verweis auf weitere Suffragien 128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (8\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -9\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Collectae feriales. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Collecte feriales ad vi et ix\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui conspicis, omni nos virtute destitui \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 30 Orationen; (9\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Collecte de confessore et pontifice retro obmisse \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui nos annua beati N. confessoris tui atque pontificis sollempnitate letificas \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 6 Orationen.}

F\u252 \'fcr Montag bis Sonntag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Confitebor tibi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 bis (53\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Benedicite\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; ferner \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Benedictus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quicumque\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Te deum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Lectiones feriales. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Lecciones feriales ad nocturnos tempore estiuo cum responsoriis suis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 symiliter ad vesperas et ad laudes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Montag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Consurge\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 lauda in nocte in principio vigiliarum et effunde sicut aquam cor tuum ante conspectum domini \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Dienstag bis Freitag; (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Samstag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Benefac iusto et invenies retribucionem magnam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Sonntag mit je einem Responsorium zu Vesper und Laudes. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -59\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Cantica nocturni tertii. Sonntag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domine, miserere nostri,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 te enim expectauimus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Is 33,2-10. 13-18; Sir 36,14-19; (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De aduentu domini\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Is 40,10-17; 42,10-16; 49,7-13; (56\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De natiuitate domini\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Is 9,2-7; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Letare\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ierusalem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 vgl. Is 66,10-16; 26,1-12; (57\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In quadragesima\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Ier 31,23-28; Os 6,1-6; So 3,8-13; (58\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De apostolis et martiribus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Is 61,6-9; Sap 3,1-8; 10,17-20; (59\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De vno martire et de confessoribus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Sir 14,22; 15,3. 4. 6; Ier 17,7-8; Sir 31,8-11; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De virginibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Sir 39,17-21; Is 61,10-11; 62,4-5; Za 2,10-13. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Vergleichs\u252 \'fcberlieferung: Laudes cantica: die beiden Schlusstexte gegen\u252 \'fcber der \u252 \'fcblichen Reihenfolge, zum Beispiel Clm 14600, 94\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , hier vertauscht. \u8210 - Lectiones feriales: etwa Clm 14741, 424\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \u8210 - Cantica nocturni tertii: im Unterschied zur \u252 \'fcblichen Fassung, etwa Clm 14744, 163\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , hier \u252 \'fcbereinstimmend mit Clm 14741, 58\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 .}

(399\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deinde si est extraneus nobiscum sepultus fit processio ad sepulchrum cum psalmo Ad te\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 leuaui \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (400\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si autem fuerit frater nostre congregacionis tunc post exequias apud feretrum habitas itur ad sepulchrum cantando hanc antiphonam Domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 suscipe me \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 mit (400\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Collecta\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tibi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 commendamus animam famuli tui (sacerdotis) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In die exequiarum proprii fratris nostri tempore aperto dicuntur in choro nostro flexis genibus septem psalmi penitanciales \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (401\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Eciam pro proprio fratre nostro per totum tricesimum omni die dicantur psalmi septem capitulares \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; ferner \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omni die habetur processio ad sepulchrum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 und \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omni die legitur vna specialis missa \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; ferner\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 agitur septimus pariter et tricesimus pariter et vnus et primus anniuersarius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item per totum tricesimum integra prebenda in cibo et potu datur pauperi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 40\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Bernardus Magdunensis: Flores dictaminum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (40\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Brieflehre \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Incipiunt flores dictaminum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8249 \'8b. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Ad doctrinam dictaminum accedentes et operam tradentes primo loco debemus cognoscere quid sit dictamen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 (46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 de conclusione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8249 \'8b \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 alia poni nataliter etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -48\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Henricus Francigena, Aurea Gemma (Exzerpt):\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 papa ad imperatorem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Calixtus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [papa II.] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 episcopus seruus s\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [ervorum] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 dei. H\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [einrico V.] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 in Christo Ihesu dei gratia Romanorum imperatori \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Quia tue nobilitatis persona \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 et elemosinas pauperioribus erogare\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash 48\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -49\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (50\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -71\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Bernardus Magdunensis: Musterbriefe und Proverbia \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Sacerdotes episcopo qui libenter ibunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Sciant omnes qui recte sapiunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 259\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (71\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Filia patri ut det ei talem maritum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8249 \'8b [o]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ccultaui quam uotum potui meum \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \endash \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 prouerbium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Quanto magis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85, \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Cum iusta lesione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85, \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Qui se sentit mundum a crimine non aborret presentiam iudicantis. Explicit summa magistri Bernardi de Magduno\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Laus tibi sit Christe quoniam labor explicit iste\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8249 \'8b. \endash 72\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -73\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Zu Verfasser, Werk und \u220 \'dcberlieferung: Franz-Josef \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Worstbrock\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 / Monika \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Klaes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 / Jutta \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 L\u252 \'fctten\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 , Repertorium der Artes dictandi des Mittelalters 1: Von den Anf\u228 \'e4ngen bis um 1200. M\u252 \'fcnchen 1992\plain \f2\lang1033\fs20 (\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 M\u252 \'fcnstersche Mittelalter-Schriften,66), S. 43-62 (diese Hs. S. 52 Nr. 9.15). Ed.: mehrere Teileditionen, aufgelistet bei \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Worstbrock/Klaes/\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 L\u252 \'fctten\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 S. 43. \endash Aufbau der Hs.: \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20\cf1 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Brieflehre, vollst\u228 \'e4ndiger Text. \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20\cf1 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Optisch nicht abgesetzter Einschub in die Flores dictaminum: Briefe 1-14 aus der Briefmustersammlung des Henricus Francigena, s. Repertorium der Artes dictandi, S. 71-79 (diese Hs. S. 78, Nr. 13.13). Druck der Briefe: Botho \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Odebrecht\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 , Die Briefmuster des Henricus Francigena, in: Archiv f\u252 \'fcr Urkundenforschung 14 (1936) S. 231-261, Abdruck der Briefe S. 242-249. \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20\cf1 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 259 Musterbriefe und drei Proverbia des Bernhard von Meung, enthalten auch in Clm 22294,30\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 . \endash Es handelt sich um eine Fassung, die zun\u228 \'e4chst im Bistum Mainz und sp\u228 \'e4ter im Raum Fulda (Kloster H\u252 \'fcnfeld)/Regensburg/W\u252 \'fcrzburg \u252 \'fcberarbeitet wurde (Repertorium der Artes dictandi, S. 52). In identischer Zusammenstellung (mit dem Einschub der 14 Briefe des Henricus Francigena 46\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 ) ist der Text in Clm 22294, 25\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 (14. Jh., aus Kloster Windberg) \u252 \'fcberliefert, nach \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Meisenzahl\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 (wie oben, S. 91) handelt es sich dabei um eine Abschrift nach vorliegender Hs.}

I-II) \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Accessus 1: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Titulus iste quatuor nomina dat suo auctori. Marcianus suum est ipsius auctoris proprium. Mineus dictus est ab habitu faciei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tuncque promptissimum est ad scientiam uirtutum posse contingere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Lutz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Remig. 1, S. 66 Z. 1-29). \endash (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 33) Interpolation: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Intencio est in hoc opusculo tractare de nuptiis Mercurii et Philologie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tractat de naturis rerum ad phisicam vel h\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [oc] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ic]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 instruit mores ad ethicam vel h\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [oc] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ic]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 argumentatur logice\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (Z. 41) Commentarius 1 ad 1.3.5: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Introducitur hoc loco quedam satyra hos uersus in honorem Hymenei cecinisse\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in amentiam uertitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Lutz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Remig. 1, S. 67 Z. 1-10). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 Interpolationen und Zus\u228 \'e4tze: (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 3) Accessus 2: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iste Romanus fuit. Romanus enim alius natione, alius subiectione, alius dignitate. In isto autem romana dignitas ex multiplicatione nominum perpenditur. Studuit principia philosophie, postmodum uero ad poesim se contulit. Poesis ergo fictio latine, a uerbo antiquitus dicto, id est poio pois, id est fingo fingis, inde poeta uictor\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (korr. zu fictor), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 de quo Oracius: Qui sic mentitur, sic veris falsa remiscet. Primum ne medio, medium ne discrepet uno\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Horatius, Ars poetica, V. 151f.). \endash (Z. 11) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Floruit quidam partim Kartagine, partim Rome, partim in Italia. Edidit libros novem, duos scilicet de nuptiis Philologie et Mercurie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quedam rei ueritate\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [m] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ex\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [s]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 equens operi finem dedit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 O'Sullivan\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 3 Z. 1-7; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Is\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u233 \'e9\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 py\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 /\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Posselt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 3 Z. 1-8). \endash (Z. 18) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Philologia quippe amor rationis interpretatur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sed hic pro ratione ponitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Nuchelmans\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 96 Z. 8-12). \endash (Z. 20) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mercurius quasi mercatorum chirios, id est dominus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod sermo inter homines ad manifestandas uoluntates medius currens, hic etiam aput\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Grecos dicitur Hermes, id est interpres\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 O'Sullivan\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 3 Z. 8-10; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Is\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u233 \'e9\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 py\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 /\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Posselt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 3 Z. 8-11). \endash (Z. 24) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Accipitur Mercurius plerumque pro humano sermone sepe est nomen cuiusdam sideris, quod est unum de septem planetis inter Uenerem et lunam constitutum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vel beneficium vel maleficium reddit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (Z. 30) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sic gladius indifferens in sui natura\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 est quoddam dampnosum nequitie instrumentum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Nuchelmans\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 96 Anm. 1). \endash (Z. 35) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Est Mercurius quidam deus celestium et terrestrium et infernorum internuncius. Habet Mercurius concubinam habet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et legitimam sponsam. Quandoque enim coniungitur Ueneri, id est superflue et inani locquacitati et tunc generat Hermafroditos, id est monstruosos et adulterinos filios\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85|| wohl Textabbruch (vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Nuchelmans\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 96 Anm. 1 als Paraphrase). \endash (Z. 40) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Antequam ueniatur ad illud, quod est de ipso libro occurrit, nobis exposicio nominum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mercurius est sermo, philologia est amor racionis, et nisi prius ista duo conueniant, scilicet facultas dicendi et res intelligendi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et precipue ille, qui omnia coniungit, de quibus in sequenti plenius dicetur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 O'Sullivan\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 4 Z. 21-32; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Is\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u233 \'e9\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 py\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 /\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Posselt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 4 Z. 2-13). \endash (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 17) Commentarius 2 ad lib. 1: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Lecturam sic construe et scias uerba Martiani patris esse, duo enim fuerunt Martiani, pater et filius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Calliopea componens connubium \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24 d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ivum]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24 pro\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [bat]\plain \f1\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 t\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [e]\plain \f1\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 an\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [nuere]\plain \f1\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 p\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [raeesse] (?) \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 aus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [picio]\plain \f1\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 car\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [minis]\lquote \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (lib. 1.4.3-4). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Audi quid sit Calliope. Calliope quasi callo pho\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [n]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 e, id est pulchra uox\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 nisi uero assit ille, qui ea sic disposuit nil per se agere possit, unde dicitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Calliope \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 pro\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [bat] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 au\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [spicio] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 an\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [nuere] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 c\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [arminis]\lquote \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 illo, enim presente bene proficitur in omni opere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Lutz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Remig. 1, S. 70 Z. 1-8; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 O'Sullivan\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 13 Z. 5-S. 14 Z. 12). \endash (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 35) Kommentare zu lib. 1.3.5-41.11 (vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Lutz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Remig. 1, S. 67 Z. 10-S. 142). \endash (12\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 5) Kommentare zu lib. 2.42.1-78.7 (vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Lutz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Remig. 1, S. 143-206); (16\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 13) expl.: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Quippe\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [defluebant] \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 quidam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (2.77.12). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Candor lactei fluminis designat deitatem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Letabunda igitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [gratesque]\lquote (2.77.14) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 nunc redit ad fabulam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \u8218 \'82[Pulcherrima multitudo adhaerebat beatorum] \plain \f1\i\ul\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ueterum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (2.78.7), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 id est p\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 hilosophorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [vel] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 poetarum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dicuntur interesse nuptiis Mercurii, quod aries tradiderunt, in quibus instruit facvndia. Explicivnt glosvle Marciani\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash Rest der Spalte sowie 17\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Der Kommentar (ohne kommentierten Text) rezipiert zu Beginn den weitverbreiteten Kommentar des Remigius Autissiodorensis (s. Accessus 1, Commentarius 1). Ab 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 beginnt, gekennzeichnet durch ein Paragraphenzeichen am Rand, ein weiterer Accessus, f\u252 \'fcr den sowohl karolingische (s. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 O\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \rquote \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Sullivan\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Is\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u233 \'e9\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 py\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 /\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Posselt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ) als auch bisher unbekannte, wohl j\u252 \'fcngere Kommentare (teils ediert von \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Nuchelmans\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , s. Lit.) verwendet wurden. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\qc\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 II (Bl. 17-26) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 18\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -23\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Commentarius in Terentii Comoedias \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Accessus: [A]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 VCTOR iste Affricanus fuit, quem destructa Kartagine, Scipio cum aliis captiuis Romam duxit. Sed cognata eius sapientia habitus est in reuerencia. Hic igitur querens placere est usus esse poetis diuersa scribere super omnia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash (Z. 20) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Est igitur intencio eius describere moralitates\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vtilitas in nobis mores informemur. Materia est argmentum, id est res ficta, que tamen fieri potuit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 id est informis materia, id est unde quinque actuum origo tam concipitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. IX\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 1-44). \endash (18\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 12) Commentarius: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vos istec intro\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (I,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Incipit narracionem, per hoc genus locucionis, quod uocatur dramaticon, ut tam loquuntur introducte persone. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 23\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -26\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Excerpta ad diversa themata spectantia \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs22 (\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 23\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -24\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Expositio difficilium Sacrae Scripturae textuum (Bibelexegese): \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qvatuor sunt regule scripture diuine, id est historia, que res gestas loquitur. Allegoria, in qua ex alio aliud intelligitur \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 secundum anagogen, celestium uitam, qui reuelata facie uident dominum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (PL 113, 63BC). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Z. 29) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In Iohanne: Pater omne iudicium dedit filio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 5,22), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 scilicet deitatem. In alio loco: Ego gloriam meam non quero, est qui querat et iudicet (Io 8,50), ergo non omne iudicium dedit filio. Solutio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Non iudicat secundum quod homo. Omne iudicium d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [edit]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 f\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ilio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 scilicet quod si equalis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 (24\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 41) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Verbi gratia. Pater familias intrat horreum et terit triticum suum, quo facto dicit, se beati promeruisse comestionem suam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in apostolo in alio loco\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Non sunt condigne passiones\plain \f2\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8\cf1 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 huius temporis ad futuram gloriam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Rm 8,18) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et ideo solus Christus meruit, quod nos per totum tempus uix diluimus peccata nostra et ideo nichil meremur, sed ipse solus mereatur. Verbi gratia de seruo, qui occidit domino suo filium suum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa120\itap0 (26\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ipse pater uidetur filio aliquid dedisse post resurrectionem, quod ante non habuit, quod in apostolo habemus. Donauit illi nomen, quod est super\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 omne\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 nomen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 (Phil 2,9), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 et sic dedit aliquid, quod ante non habuerit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Solutio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Donauit illi nomen, \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod est super omne nomen, hoc et ante resurrectionem habuit, sed post resurrectionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sed post resurrectionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (bis!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 illud positum est in euidenti, ut scirent demones et homines esse dominum et sic nichil dedit, quod ante non habuit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 (26\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 12) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui causa fornicacionis uxorem dimittit, a fornicacione debet esse inmunis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sed generaliter que a lege dei \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [ab]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 errare facit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Glossa ordinaria Mt 5,32, PL 114, 95CD). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (Nr. 1) Henri M. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Rochais\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Une collection de textes divers de S. Respondit sanctus Augustinus: Nullum bonum irremuneratum, nullum malum impunitum. Eciam super hoc dicunt doctores, quod bona facta opera in peccato mortali homini non proficiunt ad vitam eternam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nota eciam, si satisfaccio sit in peccato mortali iniuncte penitencie non valet satisfactio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (168\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Canones Poenitentiales: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sacerdos, qui in dicendis horis canonicis uel aliis diurnis officiis a consuetudine metropolitane ecclesie discrepat, sex mensibus communione priuetur, si ex contemptu hoc fecerit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (c. 32) \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 qualis autem penitencia imponi debeat parentibus, qui pueros opprimunt, d. 50 Si qua femina\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Decretum Gratiani D.50 c.29). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Matricida x annis peniteat, Vxoricida plus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. c. 17). \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (169\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 15) Antoninus Florentinus, Summa theologica p. 3, tit. 17, c. 20: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota, quod pro occulto peccato nullatenus est manifesta penitencia iniungenda aut de qua alicuius peccati commissi suspicio oriri possit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De hoc habeas e\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 odem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [itulo]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 q. cxxv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (Nr. 1) Canones mit teils identischem, h\u228 \'e4ufig jedoch abweichendem Wortlaut in: Vom Hoch-Stifft Regenspurg.
