\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 419\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -424\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Akzess- und Kommuniongebete \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (419\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -421\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Incipit accessus altaris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b. Invokationsformeln \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sancti spiritus assit nobis gracia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in adiutorium meum intende\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; Anfangsworte des Hymnus \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Veni\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 creator spiritus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 und der Psalmen 83-86, 115-116, Ps 118 Vers 169, Ps 129; (420\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Preces; (420\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Orationes. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Da\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 queso\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omnipotens deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 meorum michi veniam peccatorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quatenus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in hac presenti vita veniam accipere merear\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Deshusses\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Sacramentaire 2, Nr. 2153); ferner CO 361, 6025, 3780, 1135, 218, 800e, 3862 (Var.), 5705. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (421\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -423\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secuntur oraciones preparatiue ad dominicum sacramentum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b. \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad mensam dulcissimi conuiuii tui\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine Iesu Criste rex angelorum, ego peccator accessurus vereor et contremisco repletus viciis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad te ergo fontem misericordie lauandus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [recurro] \u8214 ? bricht ab Blattende; (422\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [Deus qui non mortem, sed penitenciam desideras peccatorum \u8230 \'85] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 a tua separer sanctitate\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in hac peregrinacione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 propicius esto michi peccatori quia tu es deus inmortalis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omnipotens deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui de indignis dignos \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 pro vniuersa congregacione et familia sancte Marie et sancti Emmerammi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ihesus Cristus filius tuus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dominus noster. Qui cum deo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnibus peccatis et viciis pollutus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 me gaudeam colocari\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Per\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 6\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Salua me\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 rex eterne glorie \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dignare largiri custodiam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (423\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -424\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Oraciones post communionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b. \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 7\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gracias tibi ago\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine sancte pater omnipotens eterne deus, qui me indignum et miserrimum peccatorem gracia tua nullis meis meritis exigentibus saciare dignatus es \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 lux vera, iocunditas plena, sacietas perfecta, leticia perpetua, gaudium quoque sempiternum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 8\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ihesus Cristus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Marie filius qui me hodie suo sanctissimo corpore\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 suo sangwine refecit et potauit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 me foueat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 protegat atque defendat et ad vitam eternam perducat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 9\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gracias tibi ago\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omnipotens deus qui me indignum peccatorem saciare et reficere dignatus es \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 lux vera et gaudium sempiternum iustorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 10\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Eya nunc oro\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 piissime deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ut sit michi hoc dulcissimum sacramentum contra omnium peccatorum meorum wlnera efficacissimum medicamentum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tecum sine fine sim beatus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 11\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gracias tibi ago\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 piissime deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod me miserum et indignum peccatorem N. ad seruicium tuum et specialiter ad officium sacerdotale elegisti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 te benedico\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 te glorifico in eternum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (1) Druck (mit Abweichungen): \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Klapper\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Schriften Johanns von Neumarkt (s.u. 430\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ), S. 108, 1-112, 2; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pro prelatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b CO 3938c; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pro salute minorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b CO 4587a; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pro opere cottidiano\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b CO 74; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pro omnibus fidelibus defunctis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b CO 16; (428\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De loco isto\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Custodi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 locum istum ab omni peccato et ab omni scandalo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Alia oracio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ne respicias peccata nostra sed respice ad deprecacionem genitricis tue \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et per intercessionem sanctorum Emmerammi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dyonisii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Wolfgangi atque omnium sanctorum tuorum quorum reliquie sunt in isto loco\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domine Ihesu Criste\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 fili dei viui\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 suscipe hos septem psalmos quos ego indignus dixi \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Litanei: eng verwandt mit M\u252 \'fcnchen, BSB, Clm 14828, 413\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 und 14829, 138\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , von deren Sondergut hier nur \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 Appolonia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 .}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 I\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -III\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Priestergebete \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (I\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -II\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Accessus altaris. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sacerdos volens officium diuinum celebrare ita intendat ante exitum ad altare scilicet sic deuote premeditando atque orando dicat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O domine Ihesu Christe fili dei viui, propitius esto mihi peccatori, et parce peccatis et negligentiis meis infinitis quibus offendi tuam maiestatem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 qui es benedictus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 laudabilis et gloriosus et superexultatus in secula seculorum. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; (II\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui de indignis dignos facis, de iniustis iustos, de peccatoribus sanctos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 munda cor et corpus meum ab omni contagione et sorde peccati \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 proficiat ad salutem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Per Christum dominum nostrum. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Vgl. Clm 14528, 189\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (II\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -III\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Suffragium de sancta Catharina. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Suffragia per totum annum sanct\u230 \'e6 Catharin\u230 \'e6 virginis et martyris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b (II\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Montag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave gemma claritatis, ad instar carbunculi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 aus AH 26 Nr. 69; Dienstag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Prudens et vigilans virgo, qualis es cum sponso illo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 aus AH 26 Nr. 69; Mittwoch \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Negotiator uerus dominus Ihesus qu\u230 \'e6siuit et inuenit preciosam margaritam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Donnerstag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quia deuotis laudibus tuam memoriam, virgo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 recolimus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Freitag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Inclyta sanct\u230 \'e6 virginis Catharin\u230 \'e6 solennia suscipiat alacriter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 aus AH 26 Nr. 69; (III\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Samstag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gaude Catharina, quam refecit lux diuina ter quaternis noctibus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 AH 29 Nr. 217; Sonntag \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Uox de coelis intonuit:\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Veni, dilecta mea, veni intra thalamum sponsi tui \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Vers \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ora pro nobis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sancta Chatarina \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Oratio \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui dedisti legem Moysi \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Bruylants\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 2, Nr. 322. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (III\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Precationes ante et post lectionem horarum. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ante lectionis horarum canonicarum inchoationem pia pr\u230 \'e6catio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Salutem mentis et corporis donet nobis Ihesus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sapientia \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (III\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 )\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 patris \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Vers zur Er\u246 \'f6ffnung der einzelnen Gebetsstunden in Seuses, Cursus de aeterna sapientia\u699 ?, s. Pius \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 K\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 nstle\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Heinrich Seueses Horologium sapientiae. Freiburg/Schweiz 1977\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Spicilegium Friburgense 23), S. 606-616 passim, erg\u228 \'e4nzt durch \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ihesu pie, Ihesu bone, Ihesu dulcissime, Ihesu amantissime, Ihesu clementissime\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 noli me derelinquere \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Horis absolutis sic pr\u230 \'e6cationes suas deo commendat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domine deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ego laudum tuarum pensum quod persolui \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et oro ut te ipsum perfectissime laudes in me. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 V\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , XII\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash XIV\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Computistica (Sententiae, Versiculi, Tabulae, Rotae) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (V\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Einteilung des Jahres in Tage und Wochen. Tage mit Erw\u228 \'e4hnung der Schaltjahrproblematik \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Annus constat ex ccclxv diebus et fere sex horis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item sex ille hore causant bisextilem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Vers\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Lxv tria c quicumque annus tenet in se\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; Wochen \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Annus partitur in ebdomados vt sequitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sex sunt ad puri\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 bis sex sunt vsque Philippi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 vier Verse \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 17612. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (V\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Einteilung in Jahreszeiten und Monate. Jahreszeiten \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Equinoctia et solsticia anni vt patet per duos versus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b (V\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Lampert\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gregori, nox est equata diei \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Proverbia 13432; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ieiunia quatuor temporum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Post crux, post cineres, post spiritus atque Lucia \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 ebd., 21984; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De quatuor partibus anni et eorum complexionibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dat Clemens hyemem, dat Petrus ver kathedratus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 ebd., 4968; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Estas sicca calens,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 autumnus siccus et algens \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 ebd., 668a. \endash \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Monate \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De numero dierum mensuum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ia, Mar, Ma, Iul, Aug, Oct, De, decem ter simul vnum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ter decem dant reliqui, sed Februus octo viginti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Prima littera vniuscuiusque mensis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 A, dam, de, ge, bat, er, ga, ci, fus, a, dri, fex\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 490; Drei Verse \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quot Kalendas, Nonas et Idus quelibet mensis habeat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Te querens sero sub rota sera se tistrum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?) / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mar\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ma\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iul\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Oct \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (V\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Einteilung in Planetenst\u228 \'e4nde und Wochentage. Planetenst\u228 \'e4nde in Bezug auf den Aderlass \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iupiter et Venus sunt boni\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sol\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mercurius et Luna sunt mediocres\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Saturnus et Mars sunt mali\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vgl. ebd., 9952. \endash Planeten und Wochentagsnamen \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quilibet planetarum dominatur in prima hora alicuius \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (erg\u228 \'e4nze: diei) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et ab isto planeta accipit denominacionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Prima dies Solis est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 altera dictaque Lune \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Thorndike/Kibre, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Sp. 1090 (7). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (XII\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 untere Blatth\u228 \'e4lfte) Verse zur Jahresplanung. Propria der Monate \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Officia duodecim mensium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pocula Ianus amat et Februus \u8218 \'82Algeo\lquote clamat \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Sieben Verse, \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 14217. \endash Terminierung des Aderlasses \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De minucione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Martini, Blasii, Philippi, Bartholomei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 His festis minuas vt longo tempore viuas \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Neun Verse, ebd., 10716. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (XII\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash XIII\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Tafel zur Datierung beweglicher Feste. (XII\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 obere Blatth\u228 \'e4lfte) Anleitung zur folgenden (Intervall- und Festtags-)Tabelle \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si scire desideras interuallum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et festa mobilia, recipe aureum numerum illius anni quem queris et nota eundem in tabula sequenti \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (XII\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Intervall- und Festtag- (u.a. Ostertag-)Tafel \u252 \'fcber beide Seiten, querst\u228 \'e4ndig. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (XIII\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 XIV\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Scheiben (Rotae) mit Anleitung zur Ermittlung von Sonntagsbuchstabe bzw. Tabula signorum \u252 \'fcber beide Seiten, querst\u228 \'e4ndig. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tabula signorum zodiaci seu eciam minucionum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b Oster- (Lunar-)Buchstabenfolge\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 A\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 z\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 con-\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 -tur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 -um \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 in mehrfachem Durchlauf; Doppelvers \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ar, Lib de vena bene fundunt, Vrna, Sagita \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cancer, Scorp media\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pisces quoque. Cetera praua\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 1387. \endash \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (Am unteren Rand beider Seiten) Suffragium f\u252 \'fcr den Aderlass. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus in adiutorium meum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Oracio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mediator dei et hominum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 homo Christe Ihesu qui\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ne eterne mortis dampnaremur supplicio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tociusque in nobis frigeat praue vero voluptatis luxus. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 198\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -213\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Collectae de sanctis \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (198\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -212\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Proprium de sanctis. Von Andreas (30.11.) bis Saturninus (29.11.). \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Collecte per totum annum ad horas canonicas de sanctis. Et primo de sancto Andrea et in vigilia eius ad vesperas termino\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qvesumus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omnipotens deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vt beatus Andreas apostolus tuus pro nobis imploret auxilium \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad laudes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tercias et secundas vesperas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Maiestatem tuam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 supliciter exoramus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad vi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad ix\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Da nobis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine quesumus deus noster\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 beati apostoli tui Andree intercessionibus subleuari \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Meist eine oder drei Orationen, die erste zu Laudes, Terz und 2. Vesper, die zweite zur Sext, die dritte zur Non. An den Marienfesten Lichtmess, Verk\u252 \'fcndigung, Himmelfahrt und Geburt sowie an den Festen von Andreas, Benedikt, Johannes dem T\u228 \'e4ufer, Petrus und Paulus, Laurentius geht dem Fest eine Oration zur Vigil, also auch zur 1.Vesper, voraus. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (212\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -213\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Commune de sanctis. In\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 den Rubriken (\u220 \'dcberschriften) genaue Angaben \u252 \'fcber Tag und Stunde des Gebrauchs der stets vollst\u228 \'e4ndig zitierten Bibelstellen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 295\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Kolophon VI \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sit laus deo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Finita sunt capitula de tempore 22. die Maii dominica Cantate. 1519\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Sonntag, den 22. Mai 1519.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 295\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -310\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 C\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 ollectae de tempore \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (295\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -307\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Proprium de tempore. Orationen f\u252 \'fcr Sonn- und Festtage von Advent bis 23. Sonntag nach Trinitatis. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequuntur nunc collecte de tempore dominica prima in aduentum domini ad vtrasque vesperas, laudes et tercias\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b (296\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Excita\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quesumus, potenciam tuam et veni \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominica 23\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Excita\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quesumus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tuorum fidelium voluntates vt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 remedia maiora percipiant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Per dominum nostrum Ihesum Cristum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (308\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -310\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Commune de tempore. Orationen f\u252 \'fcr Werktage zur Sext und Non von Montag bis Samstag von Fronleichnamsoktav bis Advent und von Epiphanieoktav bis Aschermittwoch\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9bDiebus feriatis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad sextas et nonas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui in sanctis habitas \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 sowie (309\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) von Aschermittwoch bis Palmsonntag. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequentes oraciones incipiende sunt in die cinerum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exaudi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 gemitum populi tui suplicantis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vt dignis flagellacionibus castigatus in tua miseracione respiret. Per dominum nostrum Ihesum Cristum. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 310\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Kolophon VII \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sit laus deo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Finis collectarum de tempore. In die sancti Bonifacii episcopi et martiris dominica Exaudi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Anno domini 1519. Michael Pflenczing\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dicit deo gracias\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Montag, den 6. Juni 1519.}

Jeweils der vollst\u228 \'e4ndige Evangelientext, dann die Homilie als Lektion 9-12, danach zwei bis sechs Antiphonen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Weitgehend \u252 \'fcbereinstimmend mit M\u252 \'fcnchen, BSB, Clm 14790, 189\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 -210\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 .}

Sonntag nach Pfingsten und dem 1. Adventsonntag. Mit Antiphonen, Responsorien, Versikeln. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (470\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -477\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) An acht Sonntagen aus den K\u246 \'f6nigsb\u252 \'fcchern \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Proxima dominica post trinitatis incipitur historia regum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fvit vir vnus de Ramatha \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 I Sm 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Puer autem Samuel \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 I Sm 3,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Congregantes Philistim \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 I Sm 17,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Factum est autem postquam mortuus est Saul \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 II Sm 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et rex Dauid senuerat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 III Rg 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 6\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Appropinquauerunt dies Dauid vt moreretur \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 III Rg 2,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 7\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Confirmatum est igitur regnum in manu Salomonis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 III Rg 3,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 8\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Factum est autem cum leuare vellet dominus Heliam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 IV Rg 2,1. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (477\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -481\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) An vier Sonntagen aus den Weisheitsb\u252 \'fcchern \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Historia de libro sapiencie incipitur proxima dominica post Abdon et Sennes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Parabole Salomonis filii Dauid\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Prv 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Verba Ecclesiastes filii Dauid\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Ecl 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Diligite iusticiam qui iudicatis terram \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Sap 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnis sapiencia a domino deo est \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Sir 1,1. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (481\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -483\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) An zwei Sonntagen aus dem Buch Hiob \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hystoria Iob incipitur proxima dominica post Augustinum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (also nach 28.08.)\u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vir erat in terra Hus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Iob 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Respondens autem dominus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Iob 38,1. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (483\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -487\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Drei Wochen lang aus den Anf\u228 \'e4ngen der B\u252 \'fccher Tobias, Judith und Esther \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Historia Thobie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iudith et Hester cantantur per tres ebdominas et incipiuntur in die Prothi et Iacincti \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (11.09.)\u8249 \'8b Tb 1,1; Idt 1,1; Est 1,1. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (487\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -491\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) An vier Sonntagen aus dem Buch der Makkab\u228 \'e4er \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Machabeorum historia incipitur in die Leodegarii \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2.11.)\u8249 \'8b I Mcc 1,1; I Mcc 3,1; II Mcc 1,1; II Mcc 6,18. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (491\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -498\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) An vier Sonn- und mehreren Werktagen aus den Prophetenb\u252 \'fcchern \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hystoria prophetarum incipitur in profesto sancti Wolfgangi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (30.10.)\u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et factum est in tricesimo anno \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Ez 1,1; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Factus est sermo domini ad me dicens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 :\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fili hominis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vade ad domum Israel \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Ez 3,4; Clm 14790, 151\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 -189\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 498\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Kolophon VIII \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Anno domini 1520 primo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 die Aprilis, qui fuit dominica palmarum,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 finitum est hoc breuiarium de tempore secundum consuetudinem insignis monasterii sancti Emmerammi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 episcopi et martiris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ratispone ordinis sancti Benedicti per fratrem Michaelem Pflenczing Ottingensem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 prespiterum et monachum prefati monasterii professum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sit laus deo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Memor sis eius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b.}

Lc 2,33). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Congregemus in vnum ea que in ortu Ihesu dicta scriptaque sunt \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Antiph., Resp., Capitulum, Orationes. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (502\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -505\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Gebrauchsform (Officium parvum) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequuntur nunc cursus beatissime Marie consueti per circulum anni\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 labia mea aperies\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; 3 Lektionen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In omnibus requiem quesiui et in hereditate domini morabor \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Sir 24,11); Antiph., Resp., Capitula, Orationes. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (505\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -506\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Variante zur Adventszeit \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In aduentu cursus variantur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Beata es\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Maria que credidisti \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 508\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -512\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Accessus et recessus altaris \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (508\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -510\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Accessus altaris. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur nunc accessus altaris a sacerdote ante missam dicendus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b. Antiphonae, Responsoria, Capitulum, Versus,16 Orationes \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Avres tue pietatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 mitissime Deus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 inclina indignis precibus meis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 16\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pretende\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 fidelibus tuis dexteram celestis auxilii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (509\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Oracio sancti Martini pape a sacerdote ante missam dicenda\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 17\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domine Ihesu Criste\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 fili dei viui\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 miserere mei misero peccatori et omnibus seruis tuis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (510\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Imploracio omnium sanctorum et patronorum sacerdotis ante missam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 18\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et vt efficax mea deprecacio sit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 beate Marie semper virginis suffragium peto\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Oracio ad beatissimam virginem Mariam ante missam dicenda\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 19\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O serenissima et inclita virgo mater Maria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 mater domini nostri Ihesu Cristi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 regina celi et terre \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (510\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -512\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Recessus altaris. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur recessus altaris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Inicium sancti ewangelii secundum Iohannem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In principio erat verbum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Io 1,1-14); 5 Orationes \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui tribus pueris mitigasti flammas ignium \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (511\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave sanctissima caro\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 summa vite dulcedo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 aue celestis potus ante omnia michi dulcis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (511\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ineffabilem misericordiam tuam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine Ihesu Criste\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 humiliter exoro\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gratias tibi ago\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 domine sancte pater\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omnipotens sempiterne deus qui me indignum peccatorem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 saciare dignatus es \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O benignissime domine Ihesu Criste, respice super me indignum famulum tuum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et cum latrone in celesti paradiso eternaliter te videam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 516\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -521\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Benedictiones matutinales \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (516\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -520\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Proprium de tempore et de sanctis. Von Advent bis Allerheiligen, jeweils vier oder acht zeilenweise abgesetzte Benediktionen. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In aduentu in primo nocturno\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cristus in suo aduentu, nos protegat a malorum conuentu \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85(8 Benediktionen); (516\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Weihnachten (8); Stephanus (4); Johannes Ev. (4); Unschuldige Kinder (4); (517\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Beschneidung Christi \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In die circumcisionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b (ab hier pro Fest jeweils 8 Benediktionen); Epiphanie; Mari\u228 \'e4 Reinigung; (517\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Benediktus; Mari\u228 \'e4 Verk\u252 \'fcndigung; Sonntage der Fastenzeit; (518\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Ostern; Himmelfahrt; Pfingsten; (518\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Trinitatis; Fronleichnam; \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De sancta cruce\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b; (519\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Johannes der T\u228 \'e4ufer; Petrus und Paulus; Maria Magdalena; (519\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Verkl\u228 \'e4rung Christi; Mari\u228 \'e4 Himmelfahrt; Mari\u228 \'e4 Geburt; (520\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Kirchweihe; Michael und Engel; Allerheiligen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (520\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -521\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Commune de sanctis, de tempore, de dominicis et de virgine Maria. \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Generales benedictiones de quocumque sancto volueris matutinales siue sint plures siue vnus ad duos nocturnos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cunctis malis imminentibus, eripiat nos N. suis intercessionibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (8); \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Generales benedictiones tam de tempore quam de sanctis in tercio nocturno in matutinis ad ewangelium que placent\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Per ewangelicam lectionem, det nobis Cristus suam benedictionem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (8); (521\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Generales benedictiones in matutinis ad primos duos nocturnos tam dominicis diebus quam eciam de sanctis dici possunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus pater omnipotens, sit nobis propicius et clemens \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (8); (521\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8250 \'9b\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In festiuitatibus s. Marie virginis et in eius veneracione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qvi natus est de virgine, dignetur pro nobis virginem exaudire \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Virgo deo digna, poscentibus esto benigna. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (8 Benediktionen).\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deo gracias\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .}

Sermo 3 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Adventus. \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 9\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 In der Kopfzeile: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominica secunda in aduentu domini\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tunc videbunt filium hominis venientem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 21,27). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Notandum, quod iudex sapiens quadrupliciter procedit in suo iure. Primo causas et culpas diligenter examinat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quarto\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [Christus] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ueniet cum maiestate magna ad exequendum, postquam enim sententiam dederit, ipse eam executioni demandabit, de qua Matheus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 :\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ibunt hii in supplicium eternum, iusti autem in uitam eternam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 25,46). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: Jacobus de Voragine, Sermones aurei (s.o. 19\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ), S. 13a-14b Z. 12. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 24a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Schaltzettel Nr. 1 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (24a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Introductio thematis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Johannes de sancto Geminiano dicit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sicut equus duobus latere tangitur calcaribus et melius et forcius currat viam, ita anima hominis duobus affectionibus sollicitatur, videlicet timore et amore\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ideo ex quo amore nolumus conuerti ad dominum, saltem timore supplicii et iudicii a peccatis cessemus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash (24a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur, utrum Christus in forma humana apparebit. Respondet sanctus Thomas super quarto sententiarum, dist. 46, quod sic nam Christus potuit uideri in forma humana etc videbatur ab omnibus tam bonis quam malis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vnde Gregorius super Ezechielem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Redemptor humani generis cum iudex apparuerit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Gregorius Magnus, Homeliae in Hiezechielem prophetam, lib. 1, hom. 7 \u167 \'a7 20, CCL 142, ed. Marcus \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Adriaen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 96 Z. 424-427\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 )\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 52\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Sermo in Mt 4,1-11 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Quadragesima. \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 13\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In illo tempore ductus est Ihesus in desertum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 4,1-11). \endash (53\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ductus est Ihesus in desertum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 4,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Recitative in presentis dominice themate ad laudem et gloriam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dilectissimi, scitis consuetudinis esse,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 magnatorum facta inferuntur codicibus, ut post ceterorum memoriis innotescat ad aggrediendum facta magnifica eos prouocent\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (letzte Zeile) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Primo ergo sciendum, quod secundum Crisostomum super Matheum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (53\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ieiunium est abstinencia rei male, esuries desiderium eius\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 , vsus eius est panis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ut si uolueris illa consequi, seruias eis, negligens iusticiam dei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (53\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 21) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secundo dixi, quod quattuor facta Christi tangit ewangelista memorie digna. Primum est, quod ductus est in desertum a spiritu sancto\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secundum factum domini est ieiunium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (Z. 24) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tercium factum domini est temptacio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quartum factum domini fuit gloriosa victoria \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sic ergo, karissimi, ymitemus facta domini nostri Iesu Christi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 pro posse nostro, pugnemus in deserto, hoc est monasterio eiusdem per spiritum sanctum ducti sumus fortiter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ibi odorifero odore pulchra, apostoli ferent lumina suorum, enim illuminatores orbis. Nam si princeps in ex\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [s]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 equiis amici tui manus apponeret et parentela tua de hoc gauderet, quid ergo de principe celesti etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Zitatbeleg: (a) Pseudo-Chrysostomus, Opus imperfectum in Matthaeum, PG 56, 669f. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 52a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Schaltzettel Nr. 2 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum intrasset Ihesus Jerosolymam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , ibique docebat eos de regno dei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Matheus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (nicht identifiziert; vgl. Mt 21,17 sowie Cantus 001207); \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Accesserunt ad Ihesum: Ipse meus frater, soror et mater est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 12,50) \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Homo quidam habuit duos filios, perierat et inuentus est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Lc 15,11). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur dominica Oculi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash 52a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 112\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -113\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Sermo de dignitate sacerdotum \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 22\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 In der Kopfzeile: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item sermo de dignitate sacerdotum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Refulsit sol in clypeos aureos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I Mcc 6,39). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Christus, qui est verus sol iusticie, refulsit in clippeos aureos, id est in sacerdotes, et resplenduerunt montes ab eis, id est simplices homines, qui regenerati sunt ex aqua et spiritu sancto et per fidem katholicam illuminati. De quibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [dicit] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quatuor sunt dignitates sacerdotum. Primo dicitur sacerdos quasi dans sacrum, id est sacram confessionem et sacram indulgentiam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sint opera vestra bona et glorificent patrem vestrum, qui est in celis, tunc laus erit vnicuique a deo nobis et omnibus Christi fidelibus. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Parallel\u252 \'fcberlieferung: G\u246 \'f6ttweig, StiftsB, Cod. 200, 235\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 -236\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ; Innsbruck, UuLB, Cod. 790, 67\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ; Klosterneuburg, StiftsB, CCl 205, 42\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 ra-va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \endash Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Schneyer, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Rep. 6, S. 163 Nr. 227. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 113a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Schaltzettel Nr. 3 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (113a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Est puer unus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 6,9). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hunc sermonem breuiter diuidam in duas partes. Primo dicatur ewangelium cum suis attinentibus modicis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash (In kleinerem Schriftgrad) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item secundum Ieronimum ponuntur sex rationes, quare tanta multitudo eum sequebatur, licet ewangelista solum unam ponat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [rationem] \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 a\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Q\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 uidam sequebantur eum propter comes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [s]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 acionem sicut gulosi, qui circa\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [eum] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sine labore uiuebant et regem eum facere uolebant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 propter reprehensionem, ut pharizei et scribe, de quibus Mathei 22\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Abeuntes pha\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 risei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 ]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 consilium inierunt, ut caperent Ihesum in sermone\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 22,15)\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8\cf1 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 Zitatbeleg: (a) Dicta de tempore Magistro Iohanni Hus attributa I, Sermo 25: Dom. 4 in Quadragesima, in: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 CCCM\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 239, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 ed. Jana \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 Zachov\u225 \'e1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 ,\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 S. 486 Z. 141-157. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (113a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Est puer vnus hic\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 6,9). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pro introductione occurrit dictum Aristotelis primo Ethicorum, sic d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [icit], \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quod sermones exquirendi secundum datam materiam. Et quia nunc sumus in medio quadragesime, in qua fideles precipue dicuntur actibus deuocionis insistere, actibus autem, quibus principaliter est hiis diebus insistendi sunt quinque designati per quinque partes, quibus dominus multitudinem sociauit secundum, quod dicitur in ewangelio hodierno, ut sic de qualibus nostrum possit dici veraciter istud verbum beati Andree assumptum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Est puer vnus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Am anfang dy\u776 ?ser predigt verley\u776 ?ch mir vnd euch gnad und parmherczikay\u776 ?t gott, der vater vnd der su\u776 ?n vnd der hey\u776 ?lig gey\u776 ?st, all dy\u776 ? das pegeren, dy\u776 ? sprechen mit andacht amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Von dy\u776 ?sen worten ain wenig zu sagen, kan ich nit verpringen an pesundere gnad des hey\u776 ?lig gey\u776 ?st dor vmb, daz mir dy\u776 ?e verliechen werd, so gru\u776 ?st dy\u776 ? erwerberin der gnaden, dy\u776 ? iunckfrauen Mariam mit aim\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Aue Maria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 116\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -118\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Jacobus de Voragine: Dominica IV in Quadragesima. Sermo 2 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Quadragesima. \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 24\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Accepit Ihesus pane\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 s (vgl. Mt 4,17; 11,7; 16,21). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ista dominica vocatur dominica de rosa uel dominica de panibus. Vocatur autem dominica de rosa triplici ratione. Prima ratio, quam ponit Innocencius tertius est enim quoddam consolatorium et recreatorium populis ex continuo ieiunio fatigatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dicit enim poeta: Interpone tuis interdum gaudia curis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 habebunt loci amenitatem, ideo dicit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In regno meo. Numeri 14\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quam pulchra tabernacula tua\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ut\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [h]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 orti iuxta fluuios irrigui\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Nm 24,5-6). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: Jacobus de Voragine, Sermones in dominicas et ferias Quadragesimae, hrsg. von Rodolphe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Cluyt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . Mainz: Peter Cholinus, 1616 (VD17 12:108982L), S. 103a-105b (Anfang leicht abweichend); \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Schneyer, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Rep. 3, S. 241 Nr. 246\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \endash Zitatbeleg: (a) Disticha uel dicta Catonis, lib. 3, dist. 6, in: Poetae Latini Minores 3, ed. Emil \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Baehrens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . Leipzig 1881, ND New York 1979, S. 214-236, hier S. 227. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 116a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Schaltzettel Nr. 4 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (116a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exemplum de vsurario quodam, quem suus sacerdos sepius monuit ad penitenciam, ipse respondit, quod satis esset de tempore tum cum infirmaretur sacerdos ipsum, cum quendam impetrante ad penitenciam reuocauit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium nec penitentie locus invenietur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (116a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tobie quarto. Ex substantia tua fac elemosinam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Tb 4,7-9). \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iterum panem tuum comede cum pauperibus et egenis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Tb 4,17). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et ibidem xii. Elemosina a morte liberat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Tb 12,9). \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exemplum de quodam, qui a deo obtinuit gratiam dandi eleemosinam, cui cum quadam vice obuiaret quedam mulier in uili habitu aperiens bursam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sic incessit huic, uoluit debe\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [re] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 modicum et tulit multum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 117a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Schaltzettel Nr. 5 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (117a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exemplum de elemosina de abbate Serapione, qui cum amictum suum pauperi tribuisset et alteri obuians\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et cum nihil haberem nisi ewangelium, ipsum vendidi et pauperibus dedi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (117a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exemplum de sancto Machario\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui quodam tempore defuncti vnius caput repperit et, cum orasset, interrogat ipsum caput eius esset\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (expung.) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 fuerit et respondit, se fuisse caput cuiusdam pagani\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 que Christi sanguine sunt redempti et tunc tamen precium paruipenderent\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Zitatbelege: (a) Druck: De sancto Johanne Eleemosinario, in: Jacobi a Voragine Legenda aurea vulgo historia Lombardica dicta, rec. Dresden/Leipzig 1846, cap. 27 \u167 \'a7 9, S. 131. \endash (b) \u196 \'c4hnlicher Wortlaut in: De sancto Machario, qui caput cuiusdam pagani invenit, in: Alfons \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hilka\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Die beiden ersten B\u252 \'fccher der Libri VIII miraculorum, in: Die Wundergeschichten des Caesarius von Heisterbach. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 209\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -214\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Haimo Autissiodorensis: Sermo in dominica tertia post pentecosten (hom. 112) \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Dom. 3 post pentecosten. \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 46\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Homo quidam fecit cenam magnam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 14,16). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Introductio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnipotens deus in exordio mundane formacionis ad se cognoscendum seque perpetualiter laudandum duas rationales creaturas, angelicam videlicet et humanam, condidit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 atque ad eorum saporem hominibus denunctiandum, seruum suum misit. Nam, ut ewangelista retulit, cum dicet dominus ei, qui se invitauerat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum facis prandium etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 14,12), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 verte folium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (209\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Homo, de quo loquitur ewangelista, fuit deus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (expung., korr. aus \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Christus Ihesus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ), \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 assimilat se homini propter suam bonitatem, qui\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 secundum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?, \u252 \'fcbergeschrieben) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 magnam cenam fecit, scilicet celum et terram cum affluencia bonorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sed gentilibus a ueritate remotis legem non habentibus nec prophetas scilicet non sufficiebat facilis vocatio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 c\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (213\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Z. 13) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur reprobacio vocatorum ad cenam. Dico enim vobis, quia nemo virorum istorum, qui vocati sunt, gustabit cenam meam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 14,24). \endash Schemata und Zus\u228 \'e4tze: \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Multis modis vocat nos deus omnipotens ad gloriam perpetue\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 beatitudinis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (213\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cena est duplex\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 bona\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 corporalis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 spiritualis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 sacramentalis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 celestis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 mala\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 voluptatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 crudelitatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ambicionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 supersticionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vel erroris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item cum iudeis edere est prohibitum. 28 q 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnes deinceps clerici siue laici non ad conuiuium quemquam recipiant iudeorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 illi uero a nobis oblata contemnant. Ex concilio Agat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [h]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ense\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (214\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item cenam celestem tota trinitas preparauit, ubi pater et filius et spiritus sanctus quilibet posuit sua fercula\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (214\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item in ewangelio dicitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8218 \'82\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 compelle intrare\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \lquote (Lc 14,23). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 Vbi notatur, quod compelluntur per egestatem ut filius prodigus compulsus est reuerti in domum sui patris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash 215\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: (a) PL 118, 601AC. \endash (b) Paraphrasierende Wiedergabe auf der Grundlage von PL 118, 601-608. \endash (c) Nr. 3: Canon 40 der\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 Synode von Agde\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat8 10. September 506); Druck: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Mansi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 8, Sp. 331f. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 214a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Schaltzettel Nr. 6 (eingelegt) \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nulle\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat8 [sunt]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 maiores diuicie, nulli thesauri, nulli honores\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 clericos ordinat, sacerdotes consecrat, in eterna hereditate cum sanctis angelis collocat. Augustinus de uerbo domini\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: Augustinus, Sermo 384, cap. IV, in: PL 39, 1690; vollst\u228 \'e4ndiges Zitat bei: Artur Michael \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Landgraf\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Dogmengeschichte der Fr\u252 \'fchscholastik. Bd. 3,1: Die Lehre von den Sakramenten. Regensburg 1954, S. 285 Z. 2-7. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 215a\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Schaltzettel Nr. 7 \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fratres karissimi, ex quo deus omnipotens nos per suam per suam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (! bis) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 gratiam vocauit ad ecclesiam suam. Hec est regnum celeste. Studeamus illuc tradere bonis operibus in eisdem, non humanam querendo gloriam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 respondente Christo cum pulsauerimus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen, dico uobis, nescio uos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 25,12). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 // Textabbruch.}

Zwei Scheiben untereinander zur Bestimmung der \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Littere dominicales\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 zwischen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 1450 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 und\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 1478\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 bzw. des \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Aureus numerus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ab \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 1450\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; (15\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In hiis duabus figuris precedentibus inuenies literam dominicalem et aureum numerum. Vnde si vis habere literam dominicalem tunc considera annos ab incarnacione domini et ab illis demas M .cccc. xlix. Residuos vero annos numera circulariter in figura literarum dominicalium inchoando a D rubeo inclusiue \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Similiter dum habere volueris aureum numerum tunc deponas ab annis domini M .cccc. xlix. Residuos annos computa circulariter in figura aurei numeri incipiendo ab VII inclusiue \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \u8210 - \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ibidem habebis aureum numerum pro toto anno seruientem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (15\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -16\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Tabula intervalli. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 146\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -160\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Miscellanea ascetica \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (146\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Heinrich Seuse, Horologium sapientiae, lib. 2, cap. 6: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sciendum, quod quilibet Christi fidelis et maxime religiosus precioso Christi sanguine redemptus, debet ad minus decem documenta ex passione domini elicere pro sui informacione: Primum est, quod sicut Christus dei filius imminente passione sua horrenda\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , [cum] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 pre angustiis superventure mortis guttas licet sanguineas sudando in terram funderet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vt et vita Jhesu in suo corpore tandem manifesta fiat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash Daran Gebet: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vt ergo ista impetrare ualeas, dic deuote: O domine Jhesu Christe, fili dei viui, qui pro salute humani generis tradi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tamquam tuus verus ymitator, quatenus ad tue resurrectionis gaudia feliciter merear provenire. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Edition: Henrici Susonis seu Fratris Amandi a. 1365 Horologium sapientiae. Erste kritische Ausgabe unter Ben\u252 \'fctzung der Vorarbeiten von Dominikus Planzer, O.P., hrsg. von Pius \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 K\u252 \'fcnzle\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Edition: Stimulus fratris Jacobi Mediolanensis, ed. PP. Collegii S. Quaracchi 1905 (Bibliotheca franciscana ascetica medii aevi 4), S. 6-13. \endash Lit.: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Distelbrink, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Bonaventurae scripta, S. 194-197 Nr. 217-219, bes. zur forma brevis S. 196f. Nr. 219. \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (149\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 7) Humbertus de Romanis, De eruditione religiosorum, lib. 4, pars 4, cap. 2: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qvi in statu incipientis est, cum experiencia ei desit, non debet de sensu suo confidere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 aliene tamen dispensacioni acquiescere, intendere destructioni vite secularis et viciorum extirpacioni\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 expellit autem hoc penitendo, illud resistendo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: VD16 H 5888, Anfang S. 231, 223f.). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 (149\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 8-150\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 17) Johannes de Turrecremata, Commentarius in regula s. Benedicti, cap. 58, tract. 131: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cauendum est omnino illi, qui mundo relicto ad religionem venit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et uult habere adhuc hic pecuniam aut aliquid proprium sic a demonibus lacerabitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Druck: VD16 B 1708, S. 265a-265b, Z. 49). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 (150\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , vorletzte Zeile) Bernardus Claraevallensis, In capite ieiunii, sermo 2: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Bernardus: Attende solerter, quid diligis, quid vere metuas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 hoc fiat, vt non nisi secundum eum doleas aut leteris\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (PL 183, 1818BC). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa240\itap0 (150\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 8-154\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 10) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Christus nobis tradidit hanc normam viuendi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et a malo liberet in eternum. Strophen 1-50 (AH 33, S. 201-206 Nr. 220; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 2772). \endash (151\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 25-151\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Z. 12) Vier Interpolationen zwischen Str. 11 und 12: \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad mensam residens et panem non benedicens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 388); \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 2\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sermo breuis, w\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [u]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ltus hilaris, pars detur egenis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dum comedunt fratres, comedas et tu reuerenter, pro quibus hec dantur recoles\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O lector mense, lege tractim non nimis alte\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia carminum 12717). \par \pard\fi0\li0\tx4605\ql\ri0\sb0\sa195\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: Johann \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Loserth\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Ein religi\u246 \'f6ses Gedicht Peters von Zittau, in: Mittheilungen des Vereins f\u252 \'fcr Geschichte der Deutschen in B\u246 \'f6hmen 14 (1876), S. 149-155, hier S. 151-155. Ergo sis deuotus et maturus, flebilis et sincerus.
